jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Role:
Principal Software Engineer
Location:
Wilmslow / Remote (UK)
We are The Citation Group - a collective of businesses dedicated to supporting small and medium-sized enterprises across a range of essential services. We know that running a business means juggling a lot. Our mission is to ease these pressures by providing expertise, guidance, and solutions that enable business leaders to focus on what they do best. From HR and Health & Safety to Cybersecurity, E-Learning, and ISO compliance, we’ve got you covered.

Citation Group has achieved strong growth through a combination of organic expansion and strategic acquisitions, continually broadening our expertise, services, and reach to create a one-stop shop that supports businesses across the UK, Canada and Australia.

Role Purpose

This is a hands-on engineering role at the heart of a significant platform transformation. You will be a core contributor to a squad that is actively changing how it builds, owns, and delivers software, and you will have real influence over the quality and direction of that work.
We are moving from a traditional release cycle to CI/CD, shifting shared services into team-owned boundaries, and embedding AI into how the team thinks and delivers. This is not a role where you maintain the status quo. You will be working alongside a Tech Lead to drive those changes forward, bringing technical craft and an AI-native approach to everything you build.
The right person for this role is someone who takes genuine pride in their work, wants to grow in a team that holds itself to a high standard, and is excited by the idea of building something better rather than just keeping things running.

Key Responsibilities

Hands-on Delivery

Write production-quality code every day across the full stack, covering backend, front-end, and the infrastructure that supports it.
Take ownership of features and workstreams from design through to deployment, delivering working software in shippable increments.
Contribute to technical design and architecture discussions, bringing well-reasoned input and a practical perspective.
Run technical spikes and proofs-of-concept to explore approaches and reduce uncertainty before committing to a direction.
Manage your own technical debt responsibly, keeping the codebase in a state you are proud of.

Platform Transformation

Play an active part in the decomposition of shared services into team-owned components, taking on defined pieces of that work and delivering them with care.
Support the move to CI/CD by contributing to pipeline work, writing automated tests, and adopting trunk-based development as the default way of working.
Build with observability in mind from the start, covering instrumentation, logging, and monitoring so that your team can see what their systems are doing in production.
Contribute to the team's growing DevOps capability, taking on operational responsibility for the systems you build.

Code Quality and Engineering Practice

Write clean, testable, secure code and hold that standard consistently, not just when it is convenient.
Practise test-driven development and contribute to a culture where good testing is the norm, using AI to generate scaffolding and explore edge cases as part of that workflow.
Participate actively in code review, giving and receiving feedback that improves the work and raises the bar for the whole team.
Apply secure coding practices as a matter of course: dependency management, threat awareness, and security testing.

AI-Native Engineering

Use AI natively in your engineering work, as part of how you think through problems, generate and review code, and build and test solutions.
Contribute to AI-powered workflows that improve the team's delivery capability, whether that is in automation, testing, code generation, or observability.
Engage actively with the team's AI agents and tooling, helping to refine and improve them as your understanding of what works deepens.
Bring a critical eye to AI-generated output, verifying quality and maintaining the standards you would apply to anything else you ship.

Collaboration and Growth

Work closely with your Tech Lead and teammates through pairing, mob programming, and shared problem-solving.
Support less experienced engineers where you can, sharing knowledge through code review, pairing, and day-to-day conversation.
Contribute to planning, refinement, stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives as an engaged and thoughtful team member.
Take an active interest in your own development, staying current with the technologies and practices the team uses and bringing new ideas back to the team.

Required Experience and Skills

Technical

Solid experience as a software engineer with a proven ability to deliver complex features on production systems.
Strong full-stack capability across backend and front-end development, with experience working with databases and cloud infrastructure.
Practical experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and infrastructure-as-code.
Working knowledge of cloud platforms (Azure/AWS) and containerisation (Docker/Kubernetes).
Sound security fundamentals: secure coding, dependency management, and an awareness of common vulnerabilities.
Experience working on evolving systems, including refactoring and improving existing codebases.

AI-Native Engineering Practice

Demonstrable experience using AI as a genuine part of your engineering workflow, not just as a code completion tool.
Comfortable working with AI-generated output critically, knowing how to verify, refine, and take responsibility for what ships.

Behavioural

High standards: you care about the quality of your work and take pride in shipping something you can stand behind.
Collaborative: you work well with others, share openly, and make the people around you better.
Self-directed: you can take a piece of work, make sensible decisions, and see it through without constant oversight.
Comfortable with change: you adapt well when priorities shift or approaches evolve, and you contribute positively to that process.
Curious and committed to learning: you keep developing your skills and bring new thinking back to the team.

Nice to Have

Experience in B2B SaaS or Citation domains such as HR, Health and Safety, Compliance, Certification, or eLearning.
Experience building or contributing to AI agents or automated workflows in a production context.
Experience with event-driven architectures, message queues, or reactive systems.
Contributions to open source or active participation in technical communities.

jobs.description:
Department:

Description

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to design and build the integration frameworks, services, and platform capabilities that connect AI technologies with the Infor MES platform and wider Manufacturing portfolio.

This is a hands-on engineering role focused on enabling AI-driven experiences, intelligent workflows, and agent-based solutions through secure and scalable integration patterns. Working closely with the Principal AI Lead, you will develop the tools, APIs, orchestration frameworks, and service layers that allow AI services, agents, and enterprise applications to interact effectively with manufacturing processes and operational data.

As AI becomes an increasingly important differentiator within manufacturing software, this role will help establish the reusable engineering foundations required to support future AI capabilities across the product portfolio.

Reporting to a Development Manager within the MES engineering organisation, you will collaborate closely with Product Management, Architecture, Engineering, Cloud Operations, and Infor OS teams to deliver production-ready AI solutions.

A Typical Day In The Life Includes

Designing and building integrations between MES services and AI platforms.
Developing tools, connectors, and orchestration services used by AI agents and intelligent applications.
Building secure APIs and service layers that expose MES business capabilities to AI-enabled solutions.
Developing reusable frameworks and patterns for tool execution, agent interaction, and workflow orchestration.
Working closely with the Principal AI Lead to define integration standards, platform capabilities, and architectural approaches.
Collaborating with cloud, product, and engineering teams to deliver AI-enabled manufacturing solutions.
Supporting the development of intelligent workflows spanning production, quality, maintenance, inventory, warehouse, and connected worker operations.
Designing and implementing event-driven integration patterns using modern cloud-native approaches.
Evaluating and implementing emerging AI integration technologies, frameworks, and engineering practices.
Helping establish engineering standards for security, observability, resiliency, and maintainability.
Contributing to technical design discussions and architecture reviews.
Mentoring and supporting other engineers as AI capabilities become more broadly adopted across the organisation.

Basic Qualifications

Demonstrated background of software engineering experience delivering enterprise applications or platforms.
Strong hands-on development experience using C# and .NET.
Experience building REST APIs, microservices, and distributed application architectures.
Experience designing and implementing integrations between enterprise applications and services.
Experience with cloud-native development on AWS, Azure, or similar cloud platforms.
Strong understanding of software architecture, security, scalability, reliability, and observability principles.
Experience working with event-driven architectures and asynchronous integration patterns.
Experience working with relational databases and modern data access technologies.
Experience developing reusable frameworks, libraries, or platform components.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently on complex technical challenges.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with AI platforms, MCP, tool orchestration, agent frameworks, or LLM integration.
Experience building applications that leverage Large Language Models (LLMs).
Experience with Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases, embeddings, or semantic search technologies.
Experience integrating AI services into enterprise business applications.
Experience within Manufacturing, MES, ERP, Industrial IoT, or Operational Technology environments.
Experience building SaaS or multi-tenant cloud-native platforms.
Experience with event streaming technologies and modern messaging platforms.
Experience contributing to technical architecture and engineering standards.

Infor MES is undergoing a significant transformation as we evolve towards a cloud-native SaaS platform and embed AI-driven capabilities throughout the product experience.

You will join a highly experienced engineering team with deep manufacturing knowledge, a strong culture of ownership, and a passion for building great software. We move quickly, value innovation, and give engineers the opportunity to turn ideas into production reality.

For the right individual, this role offers the opportunity to build the foundations that power next-generation AI capabilities across manufacturing solutions, working alongside experienced architects, product leaders, and engineers to shape the future of intelligent manufacturing software.

About Infor

Infor is where ambition meets impact. Join a global community of bold thinkers and innovators, where your expertise doesn't just solve problems. it shapes industries, unlocks opportunities, and creates real-world impact for billions of people. At Infor, you're not just building a career. you're helping to build what's next.

Infor is a global leader in business cloud software products for companies in industry specific markets. We have a relentless commitment to a culture based on PBM™. jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer with OAuth
jobs.description:
Technology is our how. And people are our why.

At Endava, we harness technology to drive meaningful change. By combining AI-native engineering, deep industry expertise and a people-centric mindset, we partner with leading organisations to solve complex business challenges and create digital products and platforms that make a lasting impact.

From strategy and design to engineering and operations, we help our customers accelerate innovation and transform their businesses. Join us and be part of a global team delivering work that matters.

Job Description

As part of Endava's strategic partnership with WTW, who provide data-driven, insight-led solutions in the areas of people, risk and capital, we're building dedicated software engineering teams to support WTW's Insurance Consulting and Technology Division.

WTW's Insurance Consulting and Technology business is a global leader in P&C, Life and Health insurance software and advisory services, with over 1,700 colleagues across 35 markets. More than 1,000 insurers worldwide trust our combination of advisory insight and advanced software to help them navigate complexity and drive sustainable growth.

Joining Endava, you'll work exclusively with WTW to help embed AI-enabled engineering practices, modern ways of working and deep insurance technology expertise, contributing to the next generation of products and services for insurers worldwide. Working as part of a dedicated team established through a Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) model, you'll collaborate closely with WTW while building your career as an Endava employee, supporting the long-term success of this strategic partnership.

About the Role

As a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer, you will join an experienced cross-functional engineering team responsible for designing, developing and evolving the Authentication and Authorization capability used across multiple products and engineering teams.

This is not a traditional application development role. Instead, you will help build a reusable identity platform that enables other engineering teams to adopt standardised authentication and authorisation services while improving security, developer experience and operational efficiency.

The capability provides shared identity and access management services that help applications authenticate users securely, authorise access to business resources and integrate with enterprise identity providers.

Built on Auth0, Fine-Grained Authorization (FGA) and modern Azure services, it includes reusable SDKs, reverse proxy services and developer tooling that make secure integration simpler across ICT’s technology landscape.

You will work closely with architects, product teams, platform engineers and business stakeholders helping deliver secure, scalable and high-quality technology solutions that create value for WTW and its customers. You will be expected to work with a high degree of autonomy, take ownership of significant work packages and make sound technical decisions within the agreed platform direction.

What Success Looks Like

In this role you will:

Help deliver secure, reusable authentication and authorization services used by multiple product teams.
Build high-quality .NET APIs, Angular administration tools and integration services that are maintainable and easy to operate.
Improve the reliability, scalability and security of shared identity services through well-tested engineering changes.
Support platform adoption by improving SDKs, documentation, developer tooling and integration patterns.
Contribute to automation, CI/CD and cloud platform improvements that make delivery faster and more predictable.
Collaborate with architects, product owners, QA, DevOps and consuming product teams to solve identity and access management challenges.
Actively learn, share knowledge and contribute to a positive engineering culture within the Quartz team.

Key Responsibilities

Identity Platform Development

Design, develop and maintain authentication and authorization services using modern .NET technologies.
Develop reusable platform services supporting secure authentication and authorization across multiple business applications.
Build scalable REST APIs and integration services used throughout the organisation.
Develop and maintain Angular-based administration portals supporting user, group and permission management.
Contribute to the evolution of Fine-Grained Authorization (FGA) capabilities and centralized access management services.

Platform Services & Developer Experience

Develop reusable SDKs, libraries and APIs that simplify integration with the enterprise identity platform.
Build developer tooling that improves onboarding and adoption of shared authentication services.
Improve developer experience by simplifying authentication, authorization and platform integration.
Produce and maintain technical documentation supporting engineering teams consuming the platform.
Help minimise breaking changes by designing stable, reusable platform interfaces.
Take ownership of technical designs and implementation approaches for assigned capabilities, identifying dependencies, risks and trade-offs and following work through to a production-ready outcome.
Lead focused technical work packages and provide practical guidance to other engineers contributing to the same capability.

Cloud & Platform Engineering

Develop cloud-native services running on Microsoft Azure.
Build and maintain reverse proxy capabilities using Azure API Management.
Support Infrastructure as Code implementation using OpenTofu/Terraform.
Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation using Azure DevOps.
Support continuous improvements in platform scalability, security and operational resilience.

Engineering Excellence

Write unit, integration and automated tests ensuring platform quality and reliability.
Participate in peer reviews, architecture discussions and technical design sessions.
Promote engineering best practices including Clean Code, automated testing and secure software development.
Collaborate with Product Owners, Architects, QA Engineers and Platform Engineers to deliver high-quality platform capabilities.
Support less experienced engineers through constructive reviews, knowledge sharing and technical mentoring.

Operations & Collaboration

Participate in third-line production support and on-call rotation.
Investigate production issues and contribute to platform reliability improvements.
Work closely with multiple product teams integrating with the platform.
Share knowledge and contribute to establishing long-term Endava ownership of the Authentication & Authorization capability.

Qualifications

Software Engineering

6+ years of commercial software development experience using C# and modern .NET.
Strong experience designing and developing REST APIs.
Experience building scalable enterprise applications or shared platform services.
Strong knowledge of object-oriented programming and modern software design principles.

Identity & Security

Strong understanding of OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC) and JWT.
Good understanding of modern authentication and authorization concepts.
Experience integrating applications with enterprise identity providers.
Understanding of secure API design and identity-based access control.

Cloud & Platform Engineering

Experience developing cloud-native applications on Microsoft Azure.
Experience with Azure DevOps, Git and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience using Infrastructure as Code with Terraform or OpenTofu.
Understanding of Azure API Management or similar API Gateway technologies.

Front-End Development

Experience developing Angular applications using TypeScript.
Experience building administrative or developer-facing web applications.

Engineering Practices

Experience writing automated tests (unit, integration and API testing).
Experience working in Agile Scrum teams.
Strong communication and collaboration skills.
Ability to work effectively across multiple product teams.
Ability to influence technical outcomes across team boundaries, communicate delivery risks and contribute to decisions affecting shared platform consumers.

Preferred Skills and Experience

Auth0
Fine-Grained Authorization (FGA)
Google Zanzibar authorization model
Azure API Management (APIM)
SCIM integrations
Identity Federation Datadog
Playwright
Trivy
GitLeaks
Invicti
Experience building reusable developer platforms
Experience working with enterprise shared services

Additional Information

For this position, the gross base salary starts from PLN 19 267 PLN Gross per month (full-time employment contract), determined using objective and gender-neutral criteria including skillset, experience and role responsibilities.

Our benefits offering typically include private medical insurance, dental plan, and glasses reimbursement. The figure represents the initial remuneration we expect to offer for this role and does not limit the right to equal pay for women and men performing the same work or work of equal value. All remuneration and benefits decisions are based on non-discriminatory, gender-neutral criteria, and in accordance with the Polish Labour Code amendments implementing Directive on pay transparency, we do not request or consider candidates’ current or past remuneration during the recruitment process.”

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives—because we know that inclusive teams help us deliver smarter, more innovative solutions for our customers. Responsibilities

As a Senior Software Engineer at Nexi Digital, you will drive the modernization of an established, business-critical payment platform — migrating a large ASP.NET (WebForms/MVC) monolith from .NET Framework 4.x to .NET 8, together with its database layer and system integrations, in an on-premise environment. You will combine deep .NET craftsmanship with modern, AI-assisted ways of working to make the migration faster and safer.

Analyzing the legacy codebase and shaping an incremental, low-risk migration path (module by module, no big-bang rewrites)
Designing and implementing the migration of application components from .NET Framework 4.x / ASP.NET (WebForms, MVC) to .NET 8 / ASP.NET Core
Refactoring the code towards SOLID principles and clean architecture as part of the migration, not as a separate project
Modernizing the Microsoft SQL Server data layer and the platform's integrations with surrounding systems
Using AI-assisted development tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot and LLM-based tooling) to accelerate legacy code analysis, refactoring and test generation — and helping the team adopt these practices responsibly
Building the automated test coverage (unit, integration) that makes the migration verifiable at every step
Collaborating closely with the development teams and stakeholders on scope, sequencing and technical decisions
Mentoring less experienced developers and sharing modernization know-how across the team

Benefits

Motivizer Benefits Platform
to choose and manage all your benefits in one place. You receive a budget (550 PLN monthly). You can choose medical care package, meal tickets, sports cards
(we have Multisport and on preferential terms, we have membership cards to one of the most popular Gyms), cinema tickets, shop vouchers, discounts and many more.

Language Courses
– you'll have access to a multi-language learning platform enabling you to practice you language skills and learn new ones!
Regular and systematic further training opportunities - both internally
and from external providers.
We support your ongoing learning and development.
Cooperation within an internal community
is our everyday reality. We have networking events, coding challenges, and company parties
for different occasions.

Qualifications

Successfully completed university degree in computer science or a comparable field of study
6+ years of commercial software development experience
Extensive experience with C# and .NET across generations — both .NET Framework 4.x (ASP.NET WebForms/MVC) and modern .NET (6/8) with ASP.NET Core
Hands-on experience with modernizing or migrating legacy applications (re-platforming, incremental refactoring, strangler-fig-style approaches)
Strong knowledge of software design principles and patterns, including SOLID and clean architecture
Solid experience with Microsoft SQL Server and data-layer refactoring
Practical experience with AI-assisted development (e.g. GitHub Copilot or similar LLM-based tools) as part of your daily engineering workflow
Experience with automated unit and integration testing
Fluency in Polish and very good communication in English
Availability to work in a hybrid mode. Remote workers, we invite to the office once every month

B2B Contract: 160 - 180 PLN net/h (Benefits not applicable on B2B cooperation type)

Listed on Borsa Italiana's MTA, Nexi has the scale, geographic reach and abilities to drive the transition to a cashless Europe. With its portfolio of innovative products, e-commerce expertise and industry-specific solutions, Nexi provides flexible support for the digital economy and the entire payment ecosystem globally, across a broad range of different payment channels and methods. Nexi’s technological platform and the best-in-class professional skills in the sector lets the company operate at its best in three market segments: Merchant Services & Solutions, Cards & Digital Payments and Digital Banking & Corporate Solutions. Nexi constantly invests in technology and innovation, focusing on two fundamental principles: meeting, together with its partner banks, customer needs and creating new business opportunities for them. Nexi is committed to supporting people and businesses of all sizes, transforming the way people pay and businesses accept payments. Identify and implement process improvements that reduce manual effort, increase scalability, and strengthen governance and auditability.
Perform other duties as assigned.

jobs.title: Junior Cloud DevOps Engineer (Azure)
jobs.description:
Company Description

Netcompany was founded in 2000 with the headquarters in Copenhagen, Denmark. Today, we are an international company with more than 9000+ employees working from over 10 locations. We serve a wide array of customers in their digital transformation journeys in public and private sectors across Europe.

We are excited by the challenge of doing things differently. At Netcompany we rely on one another and we develop quickly. We are team players. We change societies by creating life-changing IT solutions for variety of customers – from small private companies to large projects in the public sector. Our culture builds on low bureaucracy with a strong focus on high agility and flexibility.

Job Description

Continue your development with us

In Netcompany we focus on your personal and professional development. We offer a structured career model where you can build upon the experiences you bring with you.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will be your sparring partner for your ongoing development as well as for your personal and professional goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague in the leadership group provides you with concrete insights into the various business areas and responsibilities that match your interests and wishes.

Furthermore, you will participate in our training program, Netcompany Academy, where you will be offered courses and seminars tailored to your career stage. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your expertise. Participating alongside colleagues from across the company also creates a strong network and provides a solid foundation for your career at Netcompany, both professionally and socially.

Be a part of an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we prioritize community highly. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture that is built on collaboration and trust, and where there is always room for mutual sparring and support.

It is part of our culture and values that all employees, irrespective of backgrounds, identities, and experiences, are met with understanding and respect, as well as equal opportunities for development and well-being.

You will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate with colleagues from various cultures and nationalities, as we are an international company with offices in many countries.

We provide a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we offer a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network already early in your career.

As our new colleague in the Cloud Platform Services team, you will play a key role in agile projects for both large Danish and international customers. You have a unique opportunity to be part of a team responsible for multiple disciplines: Cloud Governance, Cloud Operations, Cloud Center of Excellence, and Cloud Consultancy.

We design and implement business-critical solutions on state-of-the-art infrastructure for customers, where you get hands-on experience with Azure. You will help build and operate our central architecture and solutions, impacting all our cloud solutions across all customers. You will ensure operations in the intersection of infrastructure, security, and the development of customer solutions. Additionally, you will have the opportunity to be lent out to other projects within the organization as a cloud consultant for both shorter and longer periods. All of which we convert to services that enhance and develop our central capability.

As a Cloud DevOps Engineer, Your Tasks Will Include

Monitoring, alerting, automation, and scaling of cloud solutions.
Creating coherence between development, operations, and security in accordance with DevOps and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles.
Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tasks, e.g., Terraform, Bicep.
Operating with Version controlling system, e.g., Git.
Automation and standardization of Cloud Infrastructure processes (PowerShell/ Azure CLI).
Design and implementation of Cloud governance solutions.
Delivering internal methods/methodologies/principles into customer projects.
Leading or contributing to technical initiatives in the internal cloud infrastructure through experience from customer projects.

Qualifications

We expect that you:

Have a bachelor's, master's, or engineering degree in ICT/IT, computer science, software/computer engineering, infrastructure, or other relevant vocational education experience.
Have experience with coding/scripting (.NET, Java, Web, PowerShell, Python) and/or DevOps (Terraform, CI/CD) from education or previous work.
Have experience with Azure or other Global Cloud Providers (e.g., AWS, GCP, OCI) from education or previous work.
Possess an analytical mindset, are motivated, and know how to work in a structured manner.
Have good communication skills and Teamwork.
Have an excellent command of the English Language (written & verbal).
Have to be a member of the on-call duty shift outside of business hours.
It would be beneficial (but not a must) if you:
Have work experience.
Have experience with infrastructure and operations.
Have experience with IaaS or PaaS services in cloud-hosted environments.
Have certification in Azure or other relevant Microsoft areas.
Have experience with Kubernetes, containers, or Docker.

Additional Information

Benefits we offer:

Scandinavian work environment.
Medical Insurance, Life Insurance, Multisport Card.
English and Danish language lessons.
Drinks, snacks & fruit available at the office.
Career development programme for each employee and regular feedback.
Internal and external training and certifications.
International cooperation with colleagues from Denmark, the Netherlands, Norway, the UK, and Vietnam.
Attractive office with a view and great location in Warsaw (Metro Wilanowska).

Do you still have questions?

Please upload your CV to our recruitment system via the link. If you haven't received answers to all your questions, feel free to reach out to pl.hr@netcompany.com

We are a Disability Confident Employer and are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment that welcomes every individual. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please send an email to pl.hr@netcompany.com for assistance.

All qualified candidates are invited to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disabilities, age, religion and beliefs, political beliefs, nationality, ethnic or social background.

jobs.description:
Join us, at Wolters Kluwer, and be part of a dynamic global technology company that makes a difference every day.

We’re innovators with impact. We provide expert software and information solutions that the world’s leading professionals rely on, in the moments that matter most. You’ll make a real difference in the lives of millions of people. Together with our customers, we help to advance sustainability, health, justice, prosperity, and commerce around the world.

You can thrive at Wolters Kluwer, where diversity is core to our collective strength and high performance. Be your unique self, share your creative ideas, do your best work, and take time to grow in our caring and inclusive culture where you can belong.

About This Role

Our team is building a central GenAI Platform to empower hundreds of product teams across the organization with scalable capabilities for rapid development, validation, and deployment of AI agents. We also drive the development of the most impactful AI agents, ensuring faster delivery and greater impact across multiple domains. With over 20 agents already launched and many more in progress, our work accelerates innovation and improves outcomes in critical industries.

You'll join a 100-engineer team within a larger organization that combines the stability of an established company with the agility of a startup. In this high-autonomy, high-impact role, you'll take problems from concept to production, mentor less experienced engineers, and lead by example. You'll design and ship full-stack systems, shape platform capabilities to empower hundreds of product teams, and directly contribute to the development of the most impactful AI agents.

Flagship Agent: UpToDate Expert AI

In Health, we’re launching UpToDate Expert AI
—a medical research and clinical reasoning agent that transforms the world’s most widely used point‑of‑care knowledge resource into a real‑time medical assistant. Millions of physicians will rely on it to accelerate differential diagnosis, refine treatment decisions, and reduce cognitive load—while maintaining rigorous safety, privacy, and guideline fidelity. Improvements you ship (latency, reliability, hallucination reduction) will translate directly into faster, higher-quality patient care at global scale.

What You’ll Do

Design and implement full‑stack applications, AI agents, and platform components that enable rapid GenAI agent development, validation, and deployment.
Build developer tooling, CI/CD, and observability for safe, fast iteration (evals, canaries, rollout/rollback, cost and quality telemetry).
Apply secure SDLC and privacy‑by‑design practices (threat modeling, least privilege).
Collaborate with product, UX, and domain experts to deliver customer‑focused solutions with measurable outcomes.
Apply current LLM patterns (RAG, retrieval, routing, tool-use, evals) to deliver measurable customer value—faster, more reliable AI systems; reduced time-to-decision; improved trust/safety metrics; and lower cost per query.
Lead by example and be heavily hands-on: drive architecture, mentor engineers, and take ownership of larger projects.

Minimum Qualifications

8+ years of professional software engineering experience.
Strong full‑stack development skills and cloud experience (AWS/Azure/GCP).
Expert in at least one, and proficient across the others:
AI Agent development and evaluation
Backend development
Frontend development
Cloud services (AWS/Azure/GCP)
CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code
Site Reliability Engineering (SRE)
Quality engineering / testing strategy
Secure SDLC and privacy by design

Proven track record delivering secure, reliable, cloud‑native systems to production.
Excellent problem‑solving, ownership, and cross‑functional communication.

Nice to have

Proven ability to deliver software products independently or as part of a small, fast-paced team.
Experience of taking AI agents from concept to production, including safety evaluations, iterative testing (e.g., A/B testing), and continuous improvement.
Experience with LangChain/LangGraph and MCP; vector/RAG systems; OpenSearch.
Worked on traditional ML tasks like training, deployment, and monitoring.
Understand how LLMs work, their failure modes, and techniques like fine-tuning and model adaptation.
Familiarity with regulatory frameworks such as SOC2, HIPAA, etc.

Stages

15‑minute intro screen
2× live coding in your preferred language
1× systems design
1× presentation of past work

Timeline:
Typically 2–4 weeks

Your first months

Month 1: Deep-dive into one platform component most aligned with your
expertise; ship small improvements while ramping up.
After onboarding: We’ll align on a high-impact area that fits your strengths
and ambitions.

To apply:

Please submit your resume
along with a brief cover letter
that includes a “Statement of Exceptional Work.”
In your cover letter, highlight one of your most impactful projects by addressing the following:

Your role and the problem space you were working in
The technical and product challenges you faced, and how you addressed them
The measurable impact of your work (e.g., metrics, outcomes, improvements)

This will help us better understand your approach to solving complex problems and the value you bring to the team.

Please do not include any proprietary or confidential information
in your submission

Be the Difference | If making a difference matters to you, then you matter to us.

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.

Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

jobs.description:
We are Reckitt

Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.

Information Technology & Digital

In IT and D, you'll be a force for good, whether you're championing cyber security, defining how we harness the power of technology to improve our business, or working with data to guide the innovation of consumer loved products.

Working globally across functions, you'll own your projects and process from start to finish, with the influence and visibility to achieve what needs to be done. And if you're willing to bring your ideas to the table, you'll get the support and investment to make them happen.

Your potential will never be wasted. You'll get the space and support to take your development to the next level. Every day, there will be opportunities to learn from peers and leaders through working on exciting, varied projects with real impact. And because our work spans so many different businesses, from Research and Product Development to Sales, you'll keep learning exciting new approaches.

About The Role

Join our Global Data & Analytics team and embark on an exciting journey to unravel the hidden insights within vast data oceans. We're dedicated to empowering smarter decisions and delivering superior products to our global consumers and customers.

As an AI Engineering Expert you will play a crucial role in developing and deploying AI and GenAI solutions to support R&D Stream. This role combines technical leadership—guiding external teams and ensuring alignment with best practices—with hands-on delivery of AI-driven solutions. You will work closely with the platform team to align the tech stack with organizational standards while staying at the forefront of AI advancements. Your ability to seamlessly integrate AI into business workflows will be instrumental in transforming insights into tangible impact.

Your responsibilities

Developing & Delivering GenAI Solutions: Lead the deployment and management of AI/GenAI capabilities, primarily leveraging existing APIs and third-party models, while ensuring practical and impactful integration into product concept creation.
Technical Leadership & Cross-Team Coordination: Guide external teams in implementing AI solutions while collaborating with internal platform and engineering teams to align with organizational standards and ensure scalability, security, and efficiency.
Stakeholder Engagement: Act as a key interface between R&D and the broader Data & Analytics ecosystem, translating business needs into AI-driven solutions and effectively communicating progress, challenges, and best practices.
AI Technology & Best Practices: Stay ahead of GenAI advancements (e.g., Transformer architectures, large language models, MLOps), assessing and integrating new tools to enhance existing AI capabilities.
Data Strategy & Infrastructure: Advocate for robust data foundations, working with data engineering teams to optimize data pipelines, storage, and processing, ensuring AI solutions are built on high-quality, well-structured data.
Measurement & Optimization: Define KPIs, conduct experiments (e.g., A/B testing), and refine AI applications based on real-world performance to maximize their impact on product innovation and decision-making.
Mentorship & Knowledge Sharing: Provide technical leadership, mentoring junior data scientists and analysts while fostering a collaborative, AI-driven culture within the Global Data Science Chapter.

The experience we're looking for

Right Education: Master’s or PhD in a quantitative field (Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, etc.).
Technical Expertise:
Strong experience developing GenAI applications using Python: hands-on experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), RAG architectures, embeddings, and prompt engineering.
Strong software engineering fundamentals, including API development, testing, version control, and maintainable code design.
Experience designing and deploying AI solutions in Azure cloud environments.
Strong knowledge of SQL and data management principles, experience with Databricks is a plus.
Familiarity with ML/LLMOps tooling, model evaluation, monitoring, and deployment practices (with e.g. LangFuse or MLflow)

Domain Knowledge: Understanding of R&D process is an advantage.
Leadership & Communication: Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to lead technical teams and bridge technical and business functions, effectively translating complex AI concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Adaptability: Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities, ready to pivot as AI technologies evolve.

The skills for success

Digital Strategy, Product Solution Architecture, Data Governance, Product Compliance, Digital Transformation, Stakeholder Relationship Management, Outstanding Communication, stakeholder engagement, Innovation Processes, Innovation, User Experience Design.

What we offer

With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.

Equality

We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

jobs.title: Senior Java Software Engineer
jobs.description:
The project is part of the Credit, Asset-backed & Securitized Products (CASP) division of an investment bank, focusing on platforms that support securitization and structured finance products. The current primary objective is migrating existing on-premise systems to a modern Microsoft Azure cloud environment, transforming legacy architecture into scalable, cloud-native solutions. It involves rebuilding and adapting systems used for structuring, processing, and distributing securities such as ABS, MBS, and CLOs. The platform integrates with trading, risk, and regulatory systems to support both real-time and batch data processing. The target architecture follows a microservices-based approach with containerized services deployed on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). Infrastructure provisioning and configuration are managed using Terraform as Infrastructure as Code. The system leverages REST APIs and event-driven communication to ensure scalability and flexibility during and after migration. Special focus is placed on maintaining data consistency, performance, and regulatory compliance throughout the transition. The project emphasizes high availability, resilience, and observability in a complex financial ecosystem. AI-assisted development tools like GitHub Copilot are integrated to enhance engineering productivity. The environment promotes modern engineering practices, automation, and continuous improvement.
Responsibilities:

Design, develop, and maintain backend services using Java 11+ and Spring Boot within a microservices architecture.
Build and enhance RESTful APIs and message-driven services supporting securitization and credit workflows.
Develop and deploy cloud-native applications on Microsoft Azure, including AKS-based container orchestration.
Use Terraform to define and manage infrastructure as code.
Work with containerization technologies (Docker) and contribute to CI/CD pipelines using GitLab or GitHub.
Implement integrations using messaging systems such as Kafka, IBM MQ, or Tibco EMS.
Collaborate on system design, ensuring scalability, resilience, and alignment with distributed architecture principles.
Develop and optimize database interactions using Azure SQL, Oracle, or Sybase.
Write and maintain unit, integration, and end-to-end tests to ensure code quality and reliability.
Implement monitoring, logging, and observability practices to support production systems.
Utilize Linux/Unix skills for troubleshooting and scripting.
Leverage AI-assisted development tools to improve efficiency while maintaining high coding standards.
Mandatory Skills Description:

• Strong object-oriented programming skills with Java 11+
• Extensive experience with Spring Boot / Spring ecosystem
• Hands-on development of Web and/or REST APIs and message-driven services
• Experience building and running containerized applications
• Strong experience with Azure cloud, including:
• Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform
• Kubernetes (AKS) and container orchestration
• Compute (VMs) and storage solutions (e.g., Azure Files)
• Solid Linux/Unix skills (shell scripting, system understanding)
• Experience with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot) integrated into development workflows
• Experience with GitLab / GitHub, IntelliJ / VSCode

IT-Arkitektcertifiering från Dataföreningen eller liknade instans.
Erfarenhet av Cisco och Ubiquitinätverkstekniker

Detta kommer du att göra

Vi arbetar med att möjliggöra våra kunders digitalseringsresor genom att vara djupt tekniska specialister på kundens teknikplattformar, med utgångspunkt i Microsofts ekosystem. Du kommer jobba med kunder som behöver hjälp att flytta upp sina On Premis miljöer till Azure. Du kommer att designa lösningarna utifrån kundens krav och Microsoft well architected framework. Samt hjälpa till att implementera lösningarna.

Vi lägger stor vikt på gemensamma teamleveranser och vi samarbetar ofta med andra team på Accigo. Därför är det viktigt att du trivs med att jobba tillsammans med andra och samtidigt tar ansvar för din egen leverans.

I din roll som Cloud-arkitekt kommer du att agera lösningsarkitekt i våra kunduppdrag, hjälpa till med införsäljning, genomföra externa och interna kompetensutvecklingsinitiativ, design och uppsättning av Azurelösningar, samt hands-on och problemlösning. Du förväntas driva uppdrag och ta stort eget ansvar i dina projekt. Du kommer med din kompetens och branscherfarenhet vara en mycket viktig länk mellan affärsverksamhet och IT-infrastrukturen i Azure.

Vårt team

Vi är ett nyfiket och samarbetsvilligt team, med ett gemensamt brinnande intresse för teknik och digitalisering. Vi ser oss som Sveriges vassaste (och gladaste) team inom våra fokusområden, och har en långsiktig strategi att växa och bli fler. Vi arbetar dagligen med varandra, både i kundleveranser och med erbjudandeutveckling och att driva våra fokusområden.

Förutom att arbeta tillsammans bjuder vi även in till frukostar där vi delar med oss av pinsamheter och udda fakta, kompetensspridning, veckovisa team-träffar och spontana fikastunder. Vi strävar efter att skapa en vardag fylld med spännande projekt och möjligheter hos kund, samt glädje, energi och gemenskap i teamet där dina idéer får ta plats.

Kompensation och förmåner

Vår förmånspolicy är utvecklad för att möta både dina professionella och personliga behov. I vårt omfattande förmånspaket ingår friskvårdsbidrag, tjänstepension och frivillig sjukvårdsförsäkring. Vår ersättningsmodell består av en konkurrenskraftig fast del och en rörlig del som ger dig möjlighet att påverka din lön baserat på din prestation och ambition. Vi erbjuder både professionell och personlig utveckling.

Har du några frågor eller är du bara nyfiken? Vi berättar gärna mer om oss över en kaffe: tyra.drakenberg@accigo.se

Accigo är ett konsultbolag som hjälper företag och organisationer med digital affärs- och verksamhetsutveckling med tekniken som möjliggörare. För oss handlar digitalisering till 90% om människor och 10% om teknik. Det är när samspelet mellan människa och teknik fungerar som digitaliseringens fulla styrka visar sig.

För många handlar digitalisering mest om teknik. För oss är det så otroligt mycket större. Digitalisering kan få både människor och organisationer att våga sikta högre, följa sina drömmar och öppna dörrar som de inte ens visste fanns. Och när man ser igenom tekniken och börjar skönja vilka möjligheter som gömmer sig där bakom. Då ser man att framtiden kan vara en fantastisk plats – fylld av mänsklig energi och värme – och digitalisering är inget annat än vår superkraft för att komma dit.

Job Category

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

We are Salesforce, the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI + Data + CRM. Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer too, driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good, you've come to the right place.

About The Role

Production experience required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.

Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers — experienced Technical Builders who design, build, and deploy agentic AI solutions directly inside enterprise customer environments. You'll work as part of a delivery team, partnering closely with a Deployment Strategist (Strategic Builder - a customer-facing advisor who shapes AI strategy and drives adoption) to co-build solutions that go live in production environments from day one. Engagements range from a single large strategic customer to multiple accounts simultaneously. The common thread is real code, real environments, and measurable business impact. This work spans configuration, customisation, and full-stack deployment — shipping solutions customers depend on.

The Builder Experience

AI-Powered Development: Ship real customer solutions, supported by best-in-class AI tools — Cursor, Claude, and Salesforce coding products like Vibes — embedded into your day-to-day workflow.
Collaborative Delivery: You'll work alongside Senior Forward Deployed Engineers and a Deployment Strategist. You'll own real components, benefit from structured mentorship from people who've shipped agentic systems at scale, and have a clear path to leading complex deliveries yourself.
Frontier Access: Our agentic AI platform is evolving in real time. You'll work on capabilities most engineers won't touch for months — spanning Agentforce, data, platform, and headless architectures and your field insight will feed directly to the product teams building them.
Continuous Innovation: You'll be expected to stay at the forefront, experimenting with emerging AI tools, models, and frameworks, and sharing what you learn with your team and customers.

What You'll Actually Be Building

Develop AI agents and experiences that take real actions for real organisations. Our solutions are in production at some of the largest enterprises on the planet. The work matters because the customers depend on it.
Design agent intelligence: prompts, reasoning, tool calls, and integration with customer systems, leveraging our Agentic AI platform and current LLM techniques.
Own technical components end-to-end: from architecture choice to deployed, validated, and observable in production.
Build and integrate data pipelines on Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks, and customer data platforms. Model the data, ship the pipeline, validate the output
Build and maintain agent performance dashboards and customer KPI reporting to track deployment health and business outcomes.
Contribute to proofs-of-concept and MVPs that move from sketch to deployable in days, not months.
Co-build alongside customers and partners, sharing best practices and enablement as you go. Leaving teams more capable after each engagement than before.
Surface platform gaps, edge cases, and field insights to senior Engineers and the product team. Your real-world experience is the product feedback loop.
Partner with the Deployment Strategist in your pod to translate customer business challenges into agentic solutions that actually ship.

You're Our Forward Deployed Engineer If…

You have 3+ years of software engineering or technical delivery experience, with at least one production system you'd be proud to walk us through - ideally in an AI tech stack, full-stack development, or working with frontier models
You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field
You have prior customer-facing technical delivery experience (consulting, professional services, or forward deployed engineering) — this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have.
You're fluent in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Apex — and willing to add to that list as the work demands.
You've been hands-on with LLMs and prompt engineering. You can explain why a prompt failed and what you'd change.
You understand data modeling, APIs, and integration patterns deeply enough to design them, not just consume them.
You can hold your own in a room with sales teams and customer architects.
You ship quality code and evaluate AI outputs with engineering rigor.
You actively tinker with the evolving AI/data landscape — piloting new tools, experimenting with new models, and staying genuinely curious about what's coming next.
You thrive in the group chat that's building something, not just talking about it.
You're excited to travel ~25% of the time, working directly alongside customers.

Nice-to-Haves

Salesforce platform experience or certifications (Administrator, Platform Developer I, Agentforce Specialist)
Familiarity with agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex) and orchestration patterns
Hands-on with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery)
Experience across specialist AI delivery areas: data engineering, platform architecture, or headless deployments

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Och även om du snart saknar sommaren, så gillar du tanken på att jobba i ett team där man har kul tillsammans, där arbetsuppgifterna är engagerande och där det är helt okej att sucka över vädret tillsammans vid kaffemaskinen.

Varför kommer du att trivas här?

Du kommer att få göra det du är bra på, tillsammans med människor som uppskattar både dig och det du gör. Och även om solen lyser med sin frånvaro, så kommer teamet att lysa upp din dag (okej, vi vet att det var lite cheesy, men du fattar vad vi menar). Så, vad säger du?

Ansökan och nästa steg

Hos oss kan du ansöka med din LinkedIn och/eller CV och du behöver inte fylla i några långa frågeformulär. I vår rekryteringsprocess tar vi alltid referenser och genomför en bakgrundskontroll innan anställning eller eventuellt erbjudande ges. Intervjuer kommer hållas löpande. Så vad väntar du på? Vi ser fram emot att höra av dig!😊

Om Columbus

Columbus är ett värdestyrt bolag med engagerade medarbetare som stöttar varandra i både framgång som motgång. Att ha en god balans mellan arbete och fritid är en självklarhet. Det kan vara allt från hämtning och lämning på förskola till väntan av det där paketet som ska levereras hem ”någon gång mellan 10-19”. Dessutom så är vi riktigt bra på att fira framgångar och det är inte ovanligt med fika, lyxfrukost och AW på kontoret. 🥳 På Columbus har vi även trevliga förmåner för att stötta våra medarbetare i livets olika stadier.

Omnium develops a 100% cloud-based Order Management System (OMS) that helps businesses consolidate and handle orders from all sales channels; e-commerce, customer service, POS systems and more. Our solution simplifies complex processes and creates a seamless and efficient shopping experience.

We like to call ourselves a start-up with eight years of experience. With some of the Nordics' largest retail and brand players in our customer portfolio and a rapidly growing market, we are well positioned for further expansion. With us, you'll help build a product in strong development – with modern technology, high pace and no legacy.

THE ROLE

As a fullstack developer at Omnium, you'll become part of a cross-functional development team. You'll work closely with a modern SaaS platform built on .NET, with Azure, Elasticsearch and Vue.js, used by some of the Nordics' largest commerce players. You'll work across the stack, from backend to frontend, and take technical ownership of how functionality is designed, built and further developed in production.

This is a domain-heavy role. Our customers are retailers and brands running high volumes across e-commerce, stores and customer service, and their business logic lives in our platform — orders, inventory, fulfilment, returns, payments, channel complexity. Setting up Omnium well means genuinely understanding how each customer operates, so we're looking for someone who recognises these processes from experience and can translate them into solid technical solutions.

HERE YOU'LL GET:

Technical ownership of the development of a complex and modern SaaS platform
Variety between back-end (C#/.NET, integrations, API development) and front-end (Vue.js)
A short path from idea to production in close collaboration with product and design
Significant influence on architecture, technical choices, priorities and how we work as a development team
The opportunity to work in a strong technical team where you actively participate in code reviews and technical discussions, contributing to better code quality, performance and stability

WE'RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO HAS

Experience building systems for retail or e-commerce, for example OMS, ERP, e-commerce platforms, POS, WMS, payments or logistics. This is a requirement: you need to understand the commerce domain, not just the code
5+ years of experience as a developer, preferably from SaaS or other complex systems in production
Solid expertise in C# and .NET and experience building robust backend services and APIs
A good understanding of architecture, domain modelling, API design and databases
The ability to make deliberate technical choices based on scalability, performance and maintainability
Experience with modern frontend frameworks is an advantage, ideally Vue.js
Strong communication skills in Norwegian and English, and the ability to explain technical issues to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

WHAT WE OFFER

Influence: Direct influence on architecture, technical choices and priorities, with short paths from technical proposal to decision.
Product and complexity: A modern and rapidly scaling SaaS platform in heavy use, with complex and business-critical problems to solve.
Startup pace, mature platform: We combine high speed and short decision paths with 8 years of experience and a strong customer portfolio.
Flexibility and security: A flexible workday, competitive terms, and solid pension and leave arrangements.
A social and supportive environment: A low threshold for humour, professional sparring and social initiatives, including company trips and events.

ABOUT THE EMPLOYER

At Omnium, we place a high value on collaboration, learning and well-being. We're an engaged team that combines extensive experience with a start-up mentality, and we work together to create an unparalleled product. With us, you'll become part of an environment where we lift each other up and share knowledge, all to ensure both our own and our customers' success.

We have been named one of the 50 fastest-growing tech companies in Norway several years in a row.

Vi har et av Norges mest erfarne Fabric-miljøer, med over 20 gjennomførte prosjekter og 30 konsulenter som jobber med Microsoft Fabric hver dag. Nå styrker vi satsingen i Oslo og ser etter deg som vil være med å bygge videre på suksessen og lede Fabric-teamet inn i neste fase.
I dag har vi våre sterkeste Fabric-miljøer i Trondheim, Hamar og Bergen. Nå står Oslo for tur. Som Head of Fabric Platform
blir du faglig leder for Fabric-satsingen i hovedstaden, med ansvar for å forme teamet, kompetansemiljøet og leveransene – støttet av et sterkt nasjonalt fagmiljø.
Dette er en hands-on rolle der du kombinerer rollen som arkitekt og teknisk lead på kundeprosjekter med å videreutvikle Fabric-miljøet i Oslo. Du bidrar til fagutvikling, kompetansedeling, pre-sales og rekruttering, og får stor frihet til å påvirke både rollen og retningen videre. Samtidig blir du en sentral stemme i vårt nasjonale Fabric-community.

Dine  ansvarsområder

Faglig ledelse av  Fabric -teamet i Oslo og ansvar for å bygge miljøet videre
Designe og  implementere moderne dataplattformer på Microsoft  Fabric  som gir kundene verdifull innsikt og muliggjør maskinlæring og generativ KI
Være arkitekt og teknisk lead i kundeprosjekter – fra rådgivning og løsningsdesign til implementering
Bidra i pre-salg, tilbudsarbeid og utvikling av vår  Fabric -leveransemodell
Bygge kompetanse i teamet gjennom fagsamlinger, sertifiseringer og tett samarbeid med  Fabric -miljøene i Trondheim, Hamar og Bergen
Sikre solide løsninger innen datamodellering, integrasjon, data  governance og rapportering

Job Requirements
Hvem ser vi etter? 

Vi tror du har solid erfaring med Microsoft Fabric og/eller tilgrensende Azure data-teknologier, og at du trives i skjæringspunktet mellom teknologi, mennesker og forretning.  Erfaring vi ser etter: 
Dyp kompetanse på Microsoft Fabric (Lakehouse, Data Factory, Synapse/Spark, Power BI, OneLake) eller sterk bakgrunn fra Azure-dataplattformer med ambisjon om å gå i front på Fabric 
Datamodellering og utvikling av datapipelines (SQL, Python, DAX, dbt e.l.) 
Erfaring som teknisk lead, arkitekt eller fagansvarlig – og lyst til å bygge et miljø, ikke bare levere prosjekter 
Kundeorientert erfaring, gjerne fra konsulentbransjen 
Stor interesse for kunstig intelligens og hvordan Fabric muliggjør KI i praksis 

Hvorfor oss? 

Et av Norges mest erfarne Fabric-miljøer: 20+ prosjekter, 30 Fabric-konsulenter og etablerte miljøer i Trondheim, Hamar og Bergen som du kan spille på fra dag én 
Muligheten til å bygge noe fra grunnen – med ryggdekning fra et etablert fagmiljø og en organisasjon i vekst 
Kompetansehevingsmuligheter, sertifiseringer og konferanser nasjonalt og internasjonalt 
Jevnlige sosiale og faglige arrangementer, hack-a-thons 
Bedriftsavtale med Sats og bedriftsidrett (Crossfit, Padel, styrketrening, Cage ball m.m.) 
Gode forsikringsordninger samt rekrutterings- og sertifiseringsbonuser 
Samarbeid i tverrfaglige team med anerkjente data scientists, systemutviklere og sikkerhetseksperter 
Mulighet til å delta i globale utviklingsteam 

Company description

Om SoftwareOne og SoftwareOne NO (tidligere Crayon Consulting) 

SoftwareOne og Crayon har slått seg sammen for å danne en global leverandør av programvare- og skytjenester drevet av AI, med en dristig visjon for fremtiden. Med tilstedeværelse i over 70 land og et mangfoldig team på over 13 000 fagfolk, tilbyr vi enestående muligheter for talent til å vokse, gjøre inntrykk og forme fremtidens teknologi.  
I kjernen av virksomheten vår er menneskene våre. Vi gir teamene våre mulighet til å jobbe på tvers av grenser, innovere uten frykt, og kontinuerlig utvikle ferdighetene sine gjennom verdensklasse lære- og utviklingsprogrammer.  
Enten du brenner for sky, programvare, data, AI, eller å bygge meningsfulle kundeforhold, vil du finne et sted å trives her. Bli med oss og vær en del av en kultur med mening, hvor ideene dine teller, veksten din støttes, og karrieren din kan bli global.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Channel Services
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about building robust, secure and innovative solutions and excited by the possibilities of AI and data-driven development? Channel Services is looking for a Software Engineer to join our team.

About the team:

We are a small, high-impact team
with big responsibility,
we own the full stack for DNB's communication services across web and mobile channels. Working in a BizDevOps model
, we sit at the intersection of business, development and operations, making sure our decisions are driven by both customer needs and technical excellence. With lean structure comes real ownership: every team member has a meaningful voice in how we build, ship and run our services. You'll be joining a tight-knit group where collaboration is close, the work is varied, and your contributions are visible.

What will your day look like?

You'll take end-to-end ownership of what you build, from scoping and specifying requirements together with stakeholders, through design and development, all the way to deployment and production operations. No handoffs, no silos. You'll work across the full backend lifecycle: designing APIs, building services, reviewing incidents and iterating quickly on feedback. Because we're a small team, you'll often be the one driving a feature from the first conversation to the last deploy. You'll collaborate directly with frontend engineers, product owners and business stakeholders to make sure what we ship is both technically sound and genuinely useful.

What kind of developer are we looking for?

We're looking for someone who wants real ownership, not just a ticket to close, but a problem to solve. You're comfortable stepping into ambiguity, asking the right questions, and turning business needs into concrete technical solutions. You take responsibility for the full lifecycle of your work and don't wait for someone else to define the next step. At the same time, you're a team player who communicates openly, shares knowledge, and helps the team grow. You thrive in a small team environment where autonomy and accountability go hand in hand.

Your knowledge and skills:

Strong expertise in Kotlin and Java, with solid knowledge of multithreading, Kotlin Coroutines, and functional Programming
Hands-on experience building and deploying production services on AWS using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or CDK), with deep understanding of API Gateway, Lambda, SQS, ECS, EC2, VPCs and networking
Proven ability to design, build and operate high-performance, low-latency distributed systems, troubleshooting at scale comes naturally to you
Strong data modelling skills across both SQL (PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (DynamoDB)
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and a DevOps mindset, you're comfortable owning services end-to-end in production
Familiarity with serverless architectures is a plus
Working knowledge of Go, auth protocols, OPA, Kubernetes and K6 is a significant advantage
Fluent in English, written and verbal; Norwegian is a plus
Relevant higher education or equivalent experience

Work location:
Oslo

What's in it for you?

Challenging tasks that allow you to grow professionally, competitive terms, a strong engineering culture, and good career opportunities. We offer good pension conditions, employee terms on DNBs products, insurance schemes, access to resorts in Norway, sports, cultural and other activities plus a wide range of discount schemes. In addition, knowledge and experiences are our most important assets, so you will have the opportunity to participate in courses and conferences such as JavaZone and NDC, both to build your own competency and to represent DNB externally. We also have flexible working hours, extra days off and reduced working hours from May to August (summertime).

Are you curious about the position, and would like to know more about how it is like to work with us?

For questions about the position, please get in touch with:
Department Manager / Sanel Sarajlija / mail:
sanel.sarajlija@dnb.no / phone:
+47 91827881

A job in Norway's largest financial group offers professional challenges in an exciting work environment with many opportunities. DNB strives to create an inclusive workplace where people thrive and feel comfortable. We believe that equality and inclusion boost innovative thinking and collective competency which contributes to create an attractive and flexible company equipped for a changeable business landscape. We are looking for skilled and motivated employees to meet customer needs and to achieve our goals. With so many varied disciplines and exciting opportunities in the future, we are looking for employees with different background, age and expertise. Are you engaged in focusing on the customer, and in addition fit our values: curious, brave and responsible, you might be exactly the person we need.

jobs.description:

Helsinki, Finland (Hybrid)
Department:
Software development

October 13, 2026

Are you ready to build the software that helps medical professionals harness the power of AI? Aiforia is transforming the world of tissue diagnostics and medical image analysis. We equip pathologists and scientists with deep learning AI to improve efficiency and consistency across clinical histopathology of cancer.

Our mission is to provide high-quality, AI-assisted solutions that enable personalized and democratized care for patients. To help us achieve this, we are looking for a driven Software Engineer to build and improve the products that bring our AI to clinical and research users.

Role and responsibilities

As a core member of our engineering team, you will work across the full stack, from back-end services to the web applications our customers use every day. You will help expand Aiforia's platform and keep our existing products robust and reliable.

Your key tasks will include:

Architecture and design: Design scalable, robust solutions across the stack, from back-end services and APIs to user-facing web features.
Software implementation: Develop, write, and optimize production-level code across the stack.
AI tooling and context: Write and maintain the specifications, repository context, and prompts that make AI workflows possible.
Quality assurance: Ensure high standards of code quality and reliability through code reviews, unit tests, and validation protocols.
Technical documentation: Write and maintain clear, accurate technical documentation to support development, regulatory compliance, and cross-team collaboration.
Product maintenance: Monitor, troubleshoot, and maintain existing products to ensure seamless performance for our users in clinical and research settings.

Who we are looking for

The ideal candidate is a versatila engineer who is comfortable moving between back-end front-end work. You write clean dove, care about the end user, and thrive in a collaborative, mission-driven environment.

Requirements:

Educational background: BSc or MSc in Computer Science, Engineering, or a closely related field.
Experience: 3+ years of relevant industry experience in full-stack or software engineering.
Technical skills: Strong programming skills and hands-on experience building and deploying web applications and back-end services in production.
Communication: Excellent teamwork and communication skills. Fluency in written and spoken English is a must.
AI-assisted development: Daily hands-on use of AI coding tools in production work. You can explain the role of agents and context in the development workflow, and how you verify the result.

What gives you an edge:

Experience and knowledge of image analysis and AI model building, and the workflows associated with them, including data management, verification metrics, and validation.
Experience building and evolving an AI harness: the infrastructure around the development process that lets agents operate as independent actors across the delivery lifecycle.
Experience improving how a team adopts AI coding tools: shared context, execution loops, and safety boundaries.
Experience with our core stack: C#/.NET.
Experience with modern front-end frameworks (e.g. React, Angular, TypeScript).
Familiarity with REST APIs, databases, and cloud computing platforms.
Experience with CI/CD, automated testing, and DevOps practices.
Previous experience working with medical devices, healthcare data, or within regulated environments (e.g. ISO 13485, FDA).

What we offer

Innovation: A chance to work at the forefront of medical AI technologies and make a real impact on patient care.
Culture: Join a supportive, enthusiastic, and multidisciplinary team of experts who are passionate about what they do.
Growth: Real opportunities for professional and career development in one of the fastest-growing sectors of health tech.

Location

Helsinki, Finland. We offer a hybrid work model that provides flexibility for your daily life. However, we hope that you will work primarily from our office during the initial stage of your employment. This ensures you receive the best possible support, a smooth onboarding experience, and the opportunity to truly get to know your team from day one.

Please note: We are unable to sponsor visas for this position.

How to apply

Are you the person we are looking for? Please, send your application by October 13, 2026 through careers.aiforia.com.
For data privacy reasons, we only accept applications submitted via the portal.
Please include a portfolio or work samples showcasing your design process and past projects.
Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis prior to the deadline, so please submit yours as soon as possible.

Before you apply: Please read Aiforia's Privacy Policy for Job Applicants before submitting your application.

Aiforia is committed to creating an environment of inclusivity in which all voices and individuals are heard. We strive toward this by providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, citizenship status, age, national origin, ancestry, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status and to affirmatively seek to advance the principles of equal employment opportunity.
