jobs.title: Cloud Architect (Azure)
jobs.description:
Grow. Make a difference. Together.

We want to help our clients understand why cloud services can support their growth and how to embark on a sustainable cloud journey. Our strong Azure expertise, combined with our highest-level Microsoft partnership, enables us to act as a long-term and trusted partner to our customers, helping them develop their cloud services securely, efficiently and with cost optimization in mind.

We are now looking to strengthen our team of Azure professionals with an Azure Architect
and invite you to join us in building a sustainable future! Sustainability is one of our core principles, and we have, for example, signed the Microsoft Partner Pledge.

As an Azure Architect, you will design, implement, maintain and continuously develop new and sustainable cloud services for a wide range of customers. Our clients include major organisations such as Valmet, S Group and Varma (customer case).

What is the role about?

We are looking for an Azure Architect with strong expertise and experience particularly in Kubernetes solutions. In this role, you will take the lead in designing and implementing demanding container solutions using Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
, ensuring that they are scalable, secure and reliable.

A key part of the role is also strategically planning future technology directions, designing environments that support evolving business needs, and driving innovation through new cloud technologies. You will play an important role in developing business continuity and resilience solutions tailored to container-based applications, guiding smooth migrations and optimising system performance for both current and future needs.

In this key role, you will work with a diverse range of clients across different industries, providing both strategic direction and technical leadership in using container technologies to transform their businesses.

As a professional at Knowit, you will have every opportunity to put your expertise to use while continuing to develop your skills with the latest modern technologies. We encourage experimentation and trying new things, and you can steer the development of your expertise in the direction that best supports your growth as a cloud professional.

Building service solutions based on Microsoft Azure cloud architectures covers the entire journey, from definition and design to development and deployment. You will work as part of client teams alongside other experienced Azure professionals, right at the intersection of technology and our clients’ businesses.

What do we expect from you?

At Knowit, we are all makers at heart: we keep our promises and approach our work with passion. We are proud of our broad expertise and take pride in what we do. Being a consultant at Knowit can be summarized as follows

The ability to present and communicate ideas, best practices, and technical solutions to various stakeholders—from development teams to non-technical audiences.
The ability to see technologies as tools for solving technical problems and delivering value.
A built-in curiosity to learn new things, experiment with new technologies and practices, develop professionally, and share knowledge with others.

In addition to the maker mindset, we expect you to have a genuine interest in the technical side of Azure. One thing all our Azure professionals have in common is the ability and willingness to do hands-on technical work when needed. You are also able to communicate fluently and confidently with both technical and non-technical stakeholders in English
.

We hope you have:

3–5 years of experience with Azure cloud services. This means an interest in designing and defining architectures and/or strong expertise in implementing them. Infrastructure as Code (IaC) is our preferred way of working.
3–5 years of experience in container orchestration, preferably in an Azure environment, particularly in designing, developing, deploying, maintaining and troubleshooting container-based applications and their architectures using technologies such as Kubernetes and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
A DevOps mindset: you understand modern approaches to building solutions using native tools and code, and actively look for opportunities to automate everything from infrastructure to business logic.
Strong expertise in designing and implementing CI/CD pipelines for container-based applications, including Azure Container Registry integrations and the use of Helm package management.
Experience in implementing and managing security practices in Kubernetes environments, such as network policies and security contexts, as well as a good understanding of Azure security tools such as Defender for Cloud.

Skills that are considered an advantage, but are not required:

Experience with Kubernetes monitoring tools such as Prometheus and Grafana
Ingress controllers and Gateway API
Azure DevOps and GitHub
Infrastructure as Code experience with Azure Bicep
Experience with GitOps tools such as FluxCD and ArgoCD
AI policies, AI Gateway and MCP servers

What do we offer you?

At Knowit, we value broad expertise as well as the willingness to explore and master new areas. We take pride in our hands-on way of working and our deep technical expertise.

And because we don't want this to be just a one-sided wish list, we want you to have the opportunity to shape your role as an expert and take ownership of your professional development, with our support. Everyone is welcome to be their whole self at Knowit, and we consider a relaxed yet professional working community valuable in its own right.

Here’s what we offer:

A fixed monthly salary of 5000 – 6600€, depending on your skills, experience and capabilities.
A team and community where it is easy to grow and get support when you need it. Our people are at different stages of their careers, and we offer opportunities that challenge and develop both recent graduates and more experienced professionals.
Our People Lead model, which has received a lot of positive feedback internally. We believe that a manager's most important responsibility is to ensure that you, as an expert, have the best possible conditions to succeed in your work and develop professionally.
Time and resources to develop your expertise during working hours, including training, certifications and guild activities. We want to invest in your professional development.
Opportunities for internal mobility. Your work can make an impact across several industries, and working with different customers gives you genuine opportunities to learn something new.
A technology-independent environment. We work with modern technologies, tools and best practices, and have strong technology partnerships with major players in the industry. At the same time, we remain curious, ready to learn new things and willing to challenge the status quo.
Flexible remote and hybrid working arrangements that adapt to different life situations.
An excellent work-life balance. We work on large and meaningful projects in sustainable digitalization, but we also recognize that everyone is a whole person and that there is more to everyday life than work.
A comprehensive range of employee benefits, including lunch, commuting and sports/culture benefits, extensive occupational healthcare, accident insurance, work equipment of your choice, recruitment and sales lead bonuses, and the possibility of temporarily working remotely from abroad.

Interested?

If what you’ve read above resonates with your professional interests and you recognize yourself in the description, we would be very happy to hear more about you!

If you have any questions or would like to have a quick chat before making your decision, please contact our Talent Acquisition Partner, Topias Niinivaara
, whose contact details can be found on our careers site.

Knowit - We are Makers of a sustainable future

Our work community in Finland consist of over 400 IT professionals and management consultants in Helsinki, Tampere, Turku, and Oulu. Our working culture consists of low hierarchies, relaxed and open atmosphere and moreover, of great people.

jobs.title: Software Engineering Specialist
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

We are looking for a Software Engineering Specialist to contribute to the development of clinical application software for patient monitoring products.

In this software engineering role, you will work as part of a multi-disciplinary agile team developing software that helps clinicians monitor patients and make timely care decisions. The work includes designing, implementing, testing, and maintaining application software for patient monitors, including visualization of physiological measurements, alarms, trends, statuses, graphics, and reliable data transfer within the system and to external networks.

You will learn and apply modern software engineering practices in a regulated medical device environment, with support from experienced engineers and the wider team. The role includes responsible use of Generative AI tools as part of the software development workflow to support productivity, learning, code quality, testing, documentation, and everyday engineering work.

This is a great opportunity for an early-career software engineer who is curious, collaborative, quality-minded, and eager to grow in health technology.

Responsibilities

Job Description

Design, implement, test, and maintain clinical application software for patient monitoring products as part of an agile software development team.
Develop software features related to visualization of medical measurements, including numbers, waveforms, statuses, trends, graphics, alarms, and measurement data transfer within the system and to external networks.
Contribute to feature development under the guidance of more experienced engineers, gradually building technical ownership of defined tasks and smaller feature areas.
Apply modern software engineering methods, tools, and practices to develop robust, maintainable, and high-quality software that meets the expectations of the medical device industry.
Participate actively in design reviews, code reviews, testing, defect analysis, and required documentation.
Write and maintain unit tests and other automated tests and contribute to improving testability and software quality.
Use AI coding assistants responsibly as part of daily software engineering work, for example in ticket investigation, code generation, test creation, documentation, refactoring, debugging, and learning, in accordance with company policies.
Work as an active member of a collaborative, multi-disciplinary agile team, contributing to shared goals and continuous improvement.
Collaborate with software engineers, testers, clinical experts, system engineers, and other stakeholders in a cross-functional, multi-cultural, and global environment.
Continuously build technical skills, product understanding, and knowledge of software development in a regulated healthcare environment.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or an equivalent field.
Hands-on experience or solid academic/project background in object-oriented software design and development, preferably with C++.
Basic understanding of modern software development practices, agile ways of working, and software quality activities such as reviews, testing, and documentation.
Experience or interest in application software, user interface development, embedded software, or software platforms.
Willingness to learn and use AI coding assistants responsibly as part of everyday software development work.
Demonstrated engineering curiosity, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
Self-starter attitude—eager and quick to learn, experiment, ask questions, and grow.
Ability and willingness to work collaboratively with team members to achieve shared goals.
Growth mindset with commitment to continuous learning and improvement.
Fluency in English, both spoken and written.
Legally authorized to work in Finland.

Desired Qualifications

Experience or coursework related to technologies used in medical or embedded software systems, such as Linux, RTOS, Qt/QML, embedded systems, configuration management, continuous integration, test automation, or Python.
Experience with user interface development, especially Qt/QML.
Basic understanding of multithreaded programming or interest in learning concurrency concepts.
Experience working with a larger code base through studies, internships, thesis work, open-source projects, or professional experience.
Interest in physiological measurements, clinical workflows, patient monitoring, or healthcare technology.
Interest in software development for safety-critical, regulated, or high-quality product environments.

We offer

Work for a great purpose—your work will help improve patient care and save lives.
A unique opportunity to learn and develop leading-edge health technologies and products.
Supportive colleagues and a team with great spirit.
Opportunity to learn from talented experts in the health technology industry.
Access to world-class processes, tools, and professionals across different functions.

Have ansvar for levering af vores SaaS-tjenester på en standardiseret og struktureret måde til kunder globalt.
Sikre driftssikkerhed og ydeevne i vores virtuelle systemer samt arbejde med løbende forbedring af vores løsninger gennem automatisering og optimering.

Drift og optimering af virtuelle systemer med fokus på stabilitet og ydeevne.
Installation, vedligeholdelse og opgraderinger af Sectras medicinske IT-produkter.
Automatisering for at effektivisere processer og minimere manuelle fejl.
Fejlfinding og problemløsning for løbende at forbedre vores tjenester.

,

Vi søger dig, der har

En Bachelor- eller kandidatgrad inden for Datateknik, Informations Teknologi, Medicoteknik eller tilsvarende.
Erfaring med at arbejde med cloud-baserede IT-løsninger og/eller komplekse IT-miljøer.
God viden om virtualisering, netværk, scripting og databasehåndtering.
En ægte interesse for teknologi og innovation samt en analytisk og løsningsorienteret tilgang.
Meget gode færdigheder i dansk og engelsk, både mundtligt og skriftligt.

Erfaringer, der er en fordel

Kompetencer inden for IT-sikkerhed, virtuelle Windows- eller Linux-miljøer, MS SQL Server AlwaysOn, Active Directory, lagringsløsninger og MS Azure.
Erfaring med arbejde med automatisering og scripting.
Tidligere erfaring med at lede eller deltage i projekter i internationale miljøer.
Interesse eller engagement uden for arbejdet, f.eks. sport, musik eller frivilligt arbejde.

Mulighed for at arbejde med avanceret teknologi, der gør en reel forskel for patienter og sundhedspersonale.
Et dynamisk og udviklende arbejdsmiljø med stor variation i arbejdsopgaver.
Muligheden for at påvirke din egen karriereudvikling og specialisere dig inden for områder, der interesserer dig.
Et team af engagerede og erfarne kolleger, der støtter og udfordrer dig.

For visse roller gennemfører vi baggrundskontrol som en del af rekrutteringsprocessen. Kontakt den ansvarlige rekrutterer, hvis du har spørgsmål om dette.

For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what’s next, at the forefront of innovation and what’s technologically possible. gas delivery systems, temperature control hardware, and factory automation, delivering real-time solutions that drive chip production. Based in Singapore, you'll collaborate with global engineering teams and play a key

role in shaping the future of semiconductor automation and equipment connectivity. You will play a key role in advancing ASM's software engineering capabilities through the responsible adoption of AI-enabled development, helping teams accelerate problem resolution, improve software quality, and scale engineering excellence across global product platforms.

What You Will Be Working On

Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain software for semiconductor manufacturing equipment.
Develop applications for Windows and real-time operating systems.
Troubleshoot and resolve issues within real-time control systems.
Diagnose and resolve software, electrical, and mechanical system issues.
Lead technical escalation e􀆯orts with field engineers and global customers.

Investigate internal and customer-reported issues and develop e􀆯ective solutions.
Evaluate and recommend software engineering tools, processes, and best practices.
Participate in system architecture, design, and scheduling initiatives.
Integrate and support factory automation interfaces, including SECS/GEM and related industry protocols.
Collaborate with automation teams to ensure reliable communication between manufacturing equipment and factory systems.

What We Are Looking For

Minimum a Bachelor's degree or Master'sdegree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
Strong software development experience using C#.
Minimum 5 years of experience in software development, either in a full-stack or systems-focused environment.
Minimum 10 years of software development experience, including software architecture and system design.
Experience developing machine control software, preferably for semiconductor manufacturing equipment.
Hands-on experience with factory automation systems.
Familiarity with SECS/GEM, GEM300, and EDA (Interface A) protocols.
Experience working with Automated Material Handling Systems (AMHS).
Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools, large language models (LLMs), and modern software engineering practices leveraging generative AI.

Strong knowledge of Windows and real-time operating systems.
Experience building multi-threaded and real-time applications.
Hands-on experience with GUI development and device drivers.
Knowledge of networking, industrial communications, and EtherCAT.
Understanding dynamic scheduling algorithms and deadlock avoidance techniques.
Ability to analyze complex system interactions and drive long-term technical improvements.
Hands-on experience integrating AI, machine learning, or data-driven solutions into production software systems or engineering workflows.

Apply Today To Be Part Of What’s Next.

We make the tech that enables the chips in devices which improve lives around the world. We do this with an eye to the future, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible through cutting-edge innovation, and driving the next wave of technological breakthroughs that shape how we live, work, and connect.

Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

The Role

Are you passionate about solving complex problems? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment? Then there’s a good chance you will love being a part of our Software Engineering – Development team at Kyndryl, where you will be able to see the immediate value of your work.

As a Software Engineering - Developer at Kyndryl, you will be at the forefront of designing, developing, and implementing cutting-edge software solutions. Your work will play a critical role in our business offering, your code will deliver value to our customers faster than ever before, and your attention to detail and commitment to quality will be critical in ensuring the success of our products.

Using design documentation and functional programming specifications, you will be responsible for implementing identified components. You will ensure that implemented components are appropriately documented, unit-tested, and ready for integration into the final product. You will have the opportunity to architect the solution, test the code, and deploy and build a CI/CD pipeline for it.

As a valued member of our team, you will provide work estimates for assigned development work, and guide features, functional objectives, or technologies being built for interested parties. Your contributions will have a significant impact on our products' success, and you will be part of a team that is passionate about innovation, creativity, and excellence. Above all else, you will have the freedom to drive innovation and take ownership of your work while honing your problem-solving, collaboration, and automation skills. Together, we can make a difference in the world of cloud-based managed services.

Your Future at Kyndryl

The career path ahead is full of exciting opportunities to grow and advance within the job family. With dedication and hard work, you can climb the ladder to higher bands, achieving coveted positions such as Principal Engineer or Vice President of Software. These roles not only offer the chance to inspire and innovate, but also bring with them a sense of pride and accomplishment for having reached the pinnacle of your career in the software industry.

Who You Are

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

Required Technical And Professional Experience

5 years of experience working as a software engineer on complex software projects
Excellent coding skills and solid development experience (Java, Python, .Net etc.) with debugging and problem-solving skills
Software development methodologies, with demonstrated experience developing scalable and robust software
Experienced in relational and NoSQL databases, data mapping, XML/JSON, Rest based web services
Knowledge of architecture design - Microservices architecture, containers (Docker & k8s), messaging queues
Deep understanding of OOP and Design patterns

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, related technical field, or equivalent practical experience
Certification in one or more of the hyperscalers (Azure, AWS, and Google GCP) - otherwise, you can obtain certifications with Kyndryl
Experience with DevOps tools and modern engineering practices

Being You

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

What You Can Expect

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at mixpanel.com.

About The Delivery Engineer Team

As a member of the Delivery Engineer team, you will own the post-sales onboarding and data health for customers. Your goal will be to drive data trust, help embed Mixpanel into our customers’ data stack, and deliver on emerging AI integrations — delivering on the full value of Mixpanel as a self-serve analytics platform. You will work and consult with GTM team members and a diverse array of customers to successfully roll out product analytics to their organization and execute on technical projects and services that delight our customers.

About The Role

As a Delivery Engineer, you will be on the front lines with our clients as they integrate Mixpanel into their core product development processes. You will lay the foundation for customers to adopt product analytics and get value from Mixpanel by delivering a world-class, on-time, and value-oriented onboarding experience. With your comprehensive project management knowledge, consultative approach, expertise in the analytics space, and technical knowledge of the modern data stack, you will lead our clients' first experience with Mixpanel as they incorporate product analytics into their data ecosystem as a foundational element. With your deep technical breadth and expertise in the analytics space, you’ll be the expert consultant on all things data and ecosystem. Can manage complex projects with assorted client stakeholders, working across teams and departments to execute real change while managing scope and timelines
Has embedded AI into their workflows and is familiar with using MCP servers, building new skills, setting context, and can credibly consult with our customers about their AI/data strategy
Has experience in customer success, client-facing professional services, consulting, or technical project management role
Excellent written, analytical, and communication skills
Strong process and/or project delivery discipline
Eager to learn new technologies and adapt to evolving customer needs

Volunteer Time Off

Make Bold Bets: We choose courageous action over comfortable progress.
Innovate with Insight: We tackle decisions with rigor and judgment - combining data, experience and collective wisdom to drive powerful outcomes.

We’re a leader in analytics with over 29,000 customers and $277M invested from prominent investors: like Andreessen-Horowitz, Sequoia, YC, and, most recently, Bain Capital. Mixpanel’s pioneering event-based data analytics platform offers a powerful yet simple solution for companies to understand user behaviors and easily track overarching company success metrics. Choosing to work at Mixpanel means you’ll be helping the world’s most innovative companies learn from their data so they can make better decisions.

Job Description

Stefanini Group is seeking an experienced Network Technical Architect to join our Hybrid Cloud & Infrastructure (HCI) cluster, within the Infrastructure Services Division.

The successful candidate will design and implement secure, resilient enterprise network solutions across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments, covering SASE, ZTNA, next-generation firewalls, SD-WAN, and complex routing.

This role combines presales support for solutioning with extensive hands-on implementation and acts as the last level of support for operational teams. It may include occasional travelling and direct technical discussions with vendors.

Job Responsibilities:

Solution Design and Implementation: Architect, deploy, and migrate enterprise network solutions end to end, including SASE, ZTNA, next-generation firewalls, SD-WAN, and campus and data center networks, remaining hands-on from day 1.
Presales Support: Act as the technical authority in presales engagements, qualifying requirements, designing target architectures, estimating effort, and contributing to RFP/RFI responses, proposals, and customer presentations.
Complex Routing and Cloud Networking: Design and implement complex routing environments (BGP, OSPF, route redistribution, traffic engineering) and cloud networking architectures in AWS and Azure, including hybrid connectivity.
Operational Escalation: Act as the last level of support for operational teams, leading root cause analysis and resolution of the most complex network and security incidents.
Vendor Engagement: Drive technical discussions with vendors and technology partners, including product evaluations, proof of concepts, roadmap reviews, and support escalations.
Documentation and Standards: Produce high-level and low-level designs, migration plans, and operational runbooks; define network standards, reference architectures, and best practices.
Training and Development: Provide training, coaching, and structured knowledge transfer to operational teams and clients on new network technologies and practices.
Continuous Improvement: Continuously evaluate and improve network architectures and strategies to adapt to changing technologies and business needs.

Job Requirements

At least 10 years of hands-on experience designing, implementing, and operating enterprise networks in complex, multi-vendor environments
At least 5 years of experience as a network architect, owning end-to-end solution design for large-scale enterprise environments.
Demonstrated ability to perform hands-on implementation from day 1, combining architecture responsibilities with direct configuration and deployment work.
Preferred: Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field preferred. Mandatory: Minimum high school diploma (or equivalent). Bachelor's degree in any field with equivalent professional experience relevant for the job.

Technical Skills:

Expert-level knowledge of routing and switching in complex environments, including BGP, OSPF,route redistribution, and traffic engineering.
Deep hands-on experience with next-generation firewalls (e.g., Fortinet FortiGate, Palo Alto Networks, Check Point), covering design, implementation, upgrades, and migrations.
Strong hands-on experience with SASE and ZTNA solutions (e.g., FortiSASE, Zscaler, Netskope,Prisma Access), from architecture through rollout and day-2 operations.
Proven experience designing and deploying SD-WAN solutions (e.g., Fortinet Secure SD-WAN, Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN, VMware VeloCloud).
Solid experience with cloud networking in AWS and/or Azure, including VPC/VNet design, Transit Gateway, Virtual WAN, ExpressRoute/Direct Connect, and hybrid connectivity.
Strong understanding of network security concepts, including segmentation, IPsec and SSL VPN, IDS/IPS, and Zero Trust principles.
Mandatory 3 years of experience acting as technical project lead, driving the technical discussions with customers, vendors, and internal stakeholders.
Knowledge of network automation and scripting (e.g., Python, Ansible, REST APIs) is considered a plus.

Soft Skills

Proficiency in English for professional communication and documentation.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and multitasking skills capable of handling a vast variety of systems.

jobs.title: Open Roles at Ulvi - Design, Writing, AI Quality, Backend
jobs.description:
We are hiring for four roles at Ulvi.

Ulvi is a character-based AI app that people talk to every day. Every character has a voice, an environment, and a capability of their own: one reads dreams, one pulls tarot, one runs breathing sessions, one helps you sort a messy decision, and new characters bring new capabilities. We launched in August 2026 and we are building for a global audience, with Türkiye and Brazil as our first focus markets. The team is small, so what you ship goes live quickly and you get to watch people actually use it.

OPEN ROLES

Character & UI Designer
— Mid-level, 3+ years

Draw our characters and design the product they live in. Two crafts, one role.
ulvi.ai/en/careers/character-ui-designer

Character Writer — Mid-level, 2+ years

Invent the cast and write them: the person, the voice, and the world they live in.
ulvi.ai/en/careers/character-writer

Conversation Quality Analyst — Mid-level, 2+ years

Read what the AI actually said, decide whether it was good, and know what to change.
ulvi.ai/en/careers/conversation-quality-analyst

Backend Developer (Laravel) — Early career, 0-3 years

Own the services behind Ulvi: identity, billing, tokens, the store, the conversation API.
ulvi.ai/en/careers/backend-developer

HOW WE WORK

- Fully remote, from anywhere in Türkiye.
- Full-time. Working hours are 10:00-18:00 (TR).
- Turkish and English day to day.
- Written-first: short status notes, decisions in documents, few meetings.
- Bring your own device: we do not provide hardware.
- Communication runs on Discord.

HOW HIRING WORKS

- We care about what you can do more than where you learned it. Nobody here will ask which university you went to, or whether you went at all.
- We read everything that comes in and shortlist from CVs and portfolios.
- We share the salary range, based on your CV and experience, before the first interview.
- If we shortlist you, we reach out with a small task. It is short, it looks like the actual work of the role, and it is different for each role.
- Depending on the task, we will ask you either to send it in ahead or to present it in the interview. If your portfolio already covers the same ground, that can count too.

HOW TO APPLY

Full descriptions and what to send are on each role's page: ulvi.ai/en/careers

Applications go to hello@ulvi.ai. If none of these are for you but someone you know fits, please pass it on.

per month (Gross in USD)

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

We are seeking a talented and motivated Senior Software Engineer with accounting and financial experience. This role offers an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for leadership and innovation.

This position is ideal for professionals who began their careers in accounting or finance and later transitioned into software engineering — individuals who now want to leverage that domain expertise to architect and scale technical solutions that solve complex financial challenges in fintech.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design, develop, and optimize high-impact systems that power Sezzle’s financial reporting, reconciliation, and automation workflows. You’ll partner closely with cross-functional teams — including Accounting and Finance — to ensure data integrity, streamline financial processes, and build robust, auditable systems that meet enterprise-grade standards.

Your role will extend beyond development. You’ll mentor engineers, shape technical direction, and bring a strong sense of ownership to every project you lead. You should be able to build high-quality, innovative, and fully performing software in compliance with coding standards, technical design, and regulatory best practices.

Compensation
:

For this senior development role, with 8+ years of experience, the compensation range is $5,000 - $9,500
USD per month. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level, offering a competitive salary to reflect the value of advanced skills and experience.

Interview Process

We believe transparency is important at Sezzle. Regularly providing feedback while setting expectations is part of our culture starting with the interview process. Advancement through each step is not guaranteed.

Application submitted (you are here)
Wonderlic test (30-40 min)
Coding assessment (:1.5 hours)
Interview with recruiters (30 min)
Interview with engineers (1 hour)
Interview with engineering leadership (30-45 min)
Offer!

What You'll Do:

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance and maintain software solutions for financial processes.
Participate fully in the software development lifecycle, from design through deployment.
Build new features and products as part of an integrated engineering team.
Leverage accounting background to identify gaps and improve automation and reconciliation workflows.
Evaluate and deploy software tools, processes, and metrics.
Provide support and consulting on software systems usage.
Ensure compliance with project plans and industry standards.
Design software applications and features in Golang
Build reports and automations using Python and SQL.
Help build out a distributed architecture, creating solutions that work within it, maintaining consistency while scaling highly
Coordinate with internal company stakeholders to design market winning products
Develop and collect metrics to drive continuous improvement of existing products
Deliver high-quality, testable features that meet reporting and compliance standards.
Mentor other engineering teammates to help elevate their experience and knowledge

What We Look For:

At least 7 years of full-stack software engineering experience
Experience bringing new ideas and building consensus on the path forward
Experience with building and serving REST APIs using Go and Java Python or a similar language.
Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.
Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

Prior experience as an accountant or financial analyst.
Solid understanding of financial operations such as reconciliation, reporting, and compliance.
Experience in banking or financial institutions is a plus
Proficient in multiple programming languages (e.g., Python, Java, Go) and experience with database systems like MySQL or PostgreSQL.
Familiarity with software engineering tools, software development methodology, and release processes.
Comfortable using observability platforms like Prometheus, or vendor solutions like NewRelic or Datadog to instrument your code for production monitoring and alerting.
Familiarity with containerized micro-service architecture deployed with Kubernetes on AWS
Demonstrated history of delivering commercial APIs and web applications

About You:

You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

Sezzle’s Technology Stack:

Languages: Golang, Typescript, Python
Frontend: Typescript - React and React Native
Backend: Golang
Database: MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes
Version Control: Git
CI/CD: Gitlab
Testing: Developer-driven, focus on automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests
Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome?

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

Overview

Who are we?

CBTW is a global tech solutions company. We empower businesses with tailored tech and business solutions that drive innovation and sustainable growth.

With over 2500 experts across 21 countries, we deliver results through flexible engagement models like: whether augmenting teams, managing complex projects, or building long-term operations.

Thanks to our 5 service lines, we specialize in:

AI & Data Platforms,
Cloud & Enterprise Platforms,
Cybersecurity,
Software Engineering,
Strategy, Product & Transformation.

More info on our website: https://cbtw.tech/

What service line will you be part of?

As a Cloud Architect, you will join our Cloud & Enterprise Platforms service line.

Cloud & Enterprise Platforms is CBTW's service line dedicated to designing, operating, and optimising the technology foundations that modern organisations rely on, from cloud infrastructure and developer platforms to enterprise collaboration and service management ecosystems.

We help our clients take control of their cloud environments, modernise their platforms, and maximise the value of their enterprise tooling.

Our clients rely on us to:

Migrate and modernise infrastructure across hybrid and multi-cloud environments,
Automate software delivery through DevOps, CI/CD, and Infrastructure as Code,
Build, secure, and govern API landscapes,
Ensure reliability and full visibility through SRE and observability practices,
Structure, govern, and optimise Atlassian platforms,
Embed AI-powered automation into cloud and collabora tion platforms.

Responsibilities

What will you do?

You will play a critical role in shaping the strategic direction and operational excellence across four key solutions: DevOps & infrastructure, Cloud Managed Services, SRE & Observability, and API Ops.

You will design, implement, and oversee the technical solutions that drive our business forward. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to create scalable, secure, and efficient systems while focusing on modern cloud architecture, API management, integration, and observability. You’ll lead a team of professionals, drive innovation and deliver solutions for our European customers.

Solution Design and Architecture
Design end-to-end technical solutions leveraging cloud-native architectures (AWS and/or Azure).
Architect scalable and secure microservices-based systems to meet business and technical requirements.
Implement best practices for system design, ensuring resilience, scalability, observability and maintainability.
API Management and Integration
Develop and manage strategies for API Gateways and API Operations (API Ops).
Ensure seamless integration across platforms, services, and third-party applications.
Implement robust API lifecycle management, including design, testing, monitoring, and deprecation.
Observability and Monitoring
Define and implement observability strategies to monitor system health, performance, and reliability.
Use tools like Datadog, Dynatrace, Prometheus, Grafana, or equivalent to track metrics, logs, and traces across services.
Ensure proactive identification and resolution of performance bottlenecks and system issues.
DevOps and Automation
Collaborate with DevOps teams to establish CI/CD pipelines for automated builds, testing, and deployment.
Drive infrastructure as code (IaC) practices using tools like Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar.
Ensure secure and efficient cloud infrastructure provisioning and maintenance.
Collaboration and Leadership
Act as a technical advisor to engineering teams, ensuring alignment with architectural best practices.
Work closely with stakeholders to define technical requirements and translate them into actionable solutions.
Mentor and guide engineering teams in adopting modern architectural and operational practices.

Qualifications

What are we looking for?

Technical Skills

Cloud Architecture: Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS and/or Azure) and designing scalable, cost-efficient solutions.
API Gateways & API Ops: Strong knowledge of API design, gateways (e.g. Kong, AWS API Gateway), and API lifecycle management.
Integration: Expertise in system integration using middleware, APIs, and event-driven architectures.
Observability: Proficiency in observability tools like Datadog, Dynatrace, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, or similar.
DevOps: Solid experience with CI/CD pipelines, IaC tools (Terraform, Ansible, etc.), and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
Microservices: In-depth understanding of microservices patterns, service mesh (e.g., Istio), and distributed systems.

Experience

Minimum of 8 years of experience in Cloud solution architecture, with at least 3 years in management & leadership roles.
Proven experience designing and implementing large-scale distributed systems.
Strong understanding of software development lifecycles and Agile methodologies.

Soft Skills

Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal with fluency in English, proficiency in French or Dutch.
Strong problem-solving abilities and a proactive mindset.
Ability to work collaboratively across teams and influence stakeholders.

Certifications

Certification in cloud platforms (AWS Solutions Architect, Azure Solutions Architect, etc.)

What are we offering?

EVOLUTION:

A career development expert will follow up on your professional path within the company and support you in shaping and growing your career,
Catalogue with a wide variety of trainings for hard and soft skills, private language classes, unlimited access to an E-learning platform (Udemy, Code Academy... ) and possibility to get certified every year,
Training days credits.

COLLABORATION:

You will join a community of [job title] experts where colleagues support each other on projects, share knowledge through workshops and events to keep learning and evolving, and build international connections, while also enjoying great moments and drinks together,
Participate in internal projects to innovate and develop our solutions portfolio,
Join one of our collectives (Wellness, Agile, RSE, Gaming ...) and share your interests with other positive thinkers,
You’ll also enjoy several unforgettable company parties throughout the year. Events that CBTW has truly mastered the art of organizing.

ON TOP OF THAT:

We offer a competitive salary with a flexible mobility package that allows you to choose options such as having mobility benefits (electric cars, electric bikes, public transportation subscription).

Your next adventure starts at CBTW!

The Gametech Innovation team

As a Mid-Level Developer

What it means on a daily basis

Own features or subsystems end-to-end, from benchmarking existing solutions and prototyping alternatives through to implementing and shipping the final tool to game teams
Write maintainable, self-explanatory code in C++ and C# within Unreal and Unity engines
Debug and profile tools and systems across engines and target platforms (console, PC, mobile) so they stay reliable in production
Maintain and extend the team's CI/CD and build pipelines so new tool versions reach game teams continuously
Use AI coding assistants in your daily workflow, experiment with new approaches and technologies, and propose the incremental improvements worth industrialising

What success will look like

In your first three months, you will be at ease in the team's codebase and delivering fixes and features on existing tools with limited guidance. From there, you will own a feature or subsystem end-to-end, you will propose improvements to tools and workflows on your own initiative and become a technical point of contact for the game teams we support.

Who you would be working with

You will be reporting to our Gametech Innovation Manager, and collaborate very closely with other Developers from the Gametech Innovation team across multiple studios worldwide, including Paris, Montreal, Bucharest, and others, offering opportunities to collaborate with colleagues from diverse backgrounds and perspectives. Day to day you will work with game programmers, technical artists and producers on Gameloft's game teams internationally.

Your recruitment journey

First interview: A conversation to explore how the role aligns with your background and to address your main questions.
Test: You will receive a short case study to complete.
Second interview: You will meet members of our technical team to present your test and talk through your approach, reasoning, and methodologies in more depth.
Final interview: You will meet a Hiring Manager to discuss your experience, vision, and how you approach game technology topics at a broader level.

Where this role can take you

This role can be a stepping stone toward a more senior position within the Gametech Innovation team, or toward specialising in a particular area such as engine, pipeline or platform technology. Internal training and mentoring from the team's senior developers are available, and internal mobility across teams and studios is possible through Gameloft's Talent Move programme.

WHO YOU ARE

Naturally curious: you enjoy digging into unfamiliar problems and exploring new engines, tools and approaches

Buscamos incorporar a nuestro equipo a un/a Ingeniero/a de QA de nivel intermedio/senior
, con experiencia y una actitud muy proactiva. En este puesto, serás responsable de diseñar, crear y mantener frameworks de automatización de pruebas, identificar riesgos de producto y riesgos técnicos, mejorar nuestra estrategia de testing y trabajar estrechamente con desarrolladores, product managers y equipo de DevOps para prevenir los problemas en lugar de limitarse a detectarlos.

Este puesto es ideal para una persona que se desenvuelva bien en entornos colaborativos, que se anticipe a los retos antes de que surjan y que impulse las buenas prácticas en automatización y estrategias de testing.

Trabajarás en un producto digital de investigación de mercados disponible en tres plataformas: Android, iOS y extensiones de navegador.

¿Qué buscamos en ti?

Tus responsabilidades:

Investigación y reporte de defectos: Identificar, reproducir, investigar y documentar claramente los defectos, incluyendo su impacto, pasos para reproducirlos, logs/evidencias y el contexto técnico (JIRA). Colaborar con los desarrolladores para llevar las incidencias hasta su resolución y evitar que vuelvan a producirse.
Gestión de la cobertura de pruebas:
Revisar de forma proactiva la cobertura de pruebas manuales y automatizadas, identificando y cubriendo cualquier vacío existente.
Estrategia y responsabilidad sobre la automatización:
Definir las estrategias, frameworks y herramientas de automatización para maximizar la cobertura y la eficiencia de las pruebas automatizadas. Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener scripts de automatización robustos, escalables y reutilizables para pruebas de API, UI e integración.
Mejora proactiva de procesos:
Analizar y mejorar los procesos de QA, identificando carencias y proponiendo mejoras antes de que afecten a la calidad del producto, fomentando una cultura de calidad desde las primeras fases del desarrollo.
Colaboración y comunicación transversal:
Participar activamente con product managers, desarrolladores, DevOps y otros stakeholders para asegurar que la calidad esté presente en todas las fases del desarrollo.
CI/CD y fiabilidad de las pruebas:
Configurar y optimizar pipelines de ejecución automatizada de pruebas dentro de entornos CI/CD, garantizando un feedback rápido y resultados fiables y consistentes.

Principales aptitudes y habilidades:

Mentalidad proactiva: con iniciativa y capacidad para anticiparse a los desafíos y actuar antes de que se conviertan en problemas.
Capacidad para liderar con el ejemplo y promover la mejora continua de la calidad.
Capacidad para equilibrar la velocidad de entrega con el nivel de testing adecuado en función del riesgo.
Buenas habilidades de comunicación y capacidad para liderar conversaciones entre equipos y cuestionar decisiones o planteamientos cuando sea necesario.
Capacidad para trabajar de forma independiente manteniendo informados y alineados a los miembros del equipo y a los stakeholders sobre los riesgos y bloqueos relevantes.
Mentalidad analítica y gran atención al detalle.
Disposición para aprender nuevas técnicas y tecnologías.
Nivel de inglés conversacional.

Imprescindibles

Sólidos conocimientos de QA: capacidad para evaluar los riesgos del producto, definir estrategias de testing adecuadas, diseñar casos de prueba efectivos, identificar carencias en la cobertura de pruebas y aplicar enfoques de testing exploratorio y basado en riesgos.
Sólida experiencia en análisis y resolución de defectos: capacidad para reproducir problemas, analizar fallos, analizar la causa y comunicar los defectos de forma clara
Más de 3 años de experiencia en QA/testing, con experiencia práctica en automatización de pruebas.
Sólidos conocimientos de programación/scripting en al menos un lenguaje (Java, Kotlin, TypeScript/JavaScript, etc.).
Experiencia práctica en testing de aplicaciones en Android e iOS, utilizando tanto dispositivos físicos como emuladores/simuladores, incluyendo pruebas de permisos, comportamiento de la aplicación en diferentes condiciones de conectividad y escenarios específicos de cada plataforma.
Experiencia práctica en automatización de pruebas web y/o móviles utilizando herramientas como Playwright, Selenium, Appium o equivalentes
Buen conocimiento del testing de APIs, bases de datos y CI/CD, incluyendo validación de APIs, SQL básico e integración de pruebas automatizadas en pipelines CI/CD.
Buen manejo de Git y de los flujos de trabajo habituales de desarrollo

Experiencia en testing de extensiones de navegador, permisos, compatibilidad entre navegadores y procesos de instalación/actualización.
Experiencia con JIRA, Confluence y Testmo.
Familiaridad con Docker y plataformas cloud como AWS.
Experiencia en pruebas de rendimiento/carga, BDD/Cucumber, accesibilidad, seguridad o pruebas visuales.

, con experiencia y una actitud muy proactiva. En este puesto, serás responsable de diseñar, crear y mantener frameworks de automatización de pruebas, identificar riesgos de producto y riesgos técnicos, mejorar nuestra estrategia de testing y trabajar estrechamente con desarrolladores, product managers y equipo de DevOps para prevenir los problemas en lugar de limitarse a detectarlos.
Este puesto es ideal para una persona que se desenvuelva bien en entornos colaborativos, que se anticipe a los retos antes de que surjan y que impulse las buenas prácticas en automatización y estrategias de testing.
Trabajarás en un producto digital de investigación de mercados disponible en tres plataformas: Android, iOS y extensiones de navegador.

¿Qué buscamos en ti?

Tus responsabilidades:

Investigación y reporte de defectos:
Identificar, reproducir, investigar y documentar claramente los defectos, incluyendo su impacto, pasos para reproducirlos, logs/evidencias y el contexto técnico (JIRA). Colaborar con los desarrolladores para llevar las incidencias hasta su resolución y evitar que vuelvan a producirse.
Gestión de la cobertura de pruebas:

Revisar de forma proactiva la cobertura de pruebas manuales y automatizadas, identificando y cubriendo cualquier vacío existente.
Estrategia y responsabilidad sobre la automatización:

Definir las estrategias, frameworks y herramientas de automatización para maximizar la cobertura y la eficiencia de las pruebas automatizadas. Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener scripts de automatización robustos, escalables y reutilizables para pruebas de API, UI e integración.
Mejora proactiva de procesos:

Analizar y mejorar los procesos de QA, identificando carencias y proponiendo mejoras antes de que afecten a la calidad del producto, fomentando una cultura de calidad desde las primeras fases del desarrollo.
Colaboración y comunicación transversal:

Participar activamente con product managers, desarrolladores, DevOps y otros stakeholders para asegurar que la calidad esté presente en todas las fases del desarrollo.
CI/CD y fiabilidad de las pruebas:

Configurar y optimizar pipelines de ejecución automatizada de pruebas dentro de entornos CI/CD, garantizando un feedback rápido y resultados fiables y consistentes.

Principales aptitudes y habilidades:

Mentalidad proactiva: con iniciativa y capacidad para anticiparse a los desafíos y actuar antes de que se conviertan en problemas.
Capacidad para liderar con el ejemplo y promover la mejora continua de la calidad.
Capacidad para equilibrar la velocidad de entrega con el nivel de testing adecuado en función del riesgo.
Buenas habilidades de comunicación y capacidad para liderar conversaciones entre equipos y cuestionar decisiones o planteamientos cuando sea necesario.
Capacidad para trabajar de forma independiente manteniendo informados y alineados a los miembros del equipo y a los stakeholders sobre los riesgos y bloqueos relevantes.
Mentalidad analítica y gran atención al detalle.
Disposición para aprender nuevas técnicas y tecnologías.
Nivel de inglés conversacional.

Lo que buscamos en ti:

Imprescindibles

Sólidos conocimientos de QA:
capacidad para evaluar los riesgos del producto, definir estrategias de testing adecuadas, diseñar casos de prueba efectivos, identificar carencias en la cobertura de pruebas y aplicar enfoques de testing exploratorio y basado en riesgos.
Sólida experiencia en análisis y resolución de defectos:
capacidad para reproducir problemas, analizar fallos, analizar la causa y comunicar los defectos de forma clara
Más de 3 años de experiencia en QA/testing, con experiencia práctica en automatización de pruebas.

Sólidos conocimientos de programación/scripting en al menos un lenguaje (Java, Kotlin, TypeScript/JavaScript, etc.).

Experiencia práctica en testing de aplicaciones en Android e iOS, utilizando tanto dispositivos físicos como emuladores/simuladores, incluyendo pruebas de permisos, comportamiento de la aplicación en diferentes condiciones de conectividad y escenarios específicos de cada plataforma.

Experiencia práctica en automatización de pruebas web y/o móviles utilizando herramientas como Playwright, Selenium, Appium o equivalentes

Buen conocimiento del testing de APIs, bases de datos y CI/CD, incluyendo validación de APIs, SQL básico e integración de pruebas automatizadas en pipelines CI/CD.

Buen manejo de Git y de los flujos de trabajo habituales de desarrollo

Se valorará

Experiencia en testing de extensiones de navegador, permisos, compatibilidad entre navegadores y procesos de instalación/actualización.

jobs.title: SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER (PUBLIC KEY INFRASTRUCTURE)
jobs.description:
Get to know the role

NETLOCK's certificate authority is the system behind every qualified certificate we issue - the platform that decides what a signature is actually worth. It has recently been modernised and now runs on Kubernetes. You'll own where it goes from here: the architecture, the reliability, and the cryptographic stack it's built on. This is a backend role, written in C, Go and Perl
. We don't expect all three on day one - we expect real strength in one and a genuine willingness to work across the rest. You'll develop the CA system and the independent services around it, work directly with hardware security modules and the interfaces connecting them to our services, and make architectural decisions in a system where correctness is the product. There is some web-related work, but it isn't the focus. You'll join a small, senior-leaning team that owns what it ships, from design through production. Cryptography and PKI (Public Key Infrastructure) experience is welcome, but it isn't a prerequisite: the domain is learnable, and we'll help you get there. What we can't teach is the appetite for taking long-term responsibility for a system rather than just delivering features into it.

What we offer?

You will be part of a young, supportive, and dynamic team where junior and more experienced colleagues collaborate closely, support each other, and openly share their knowledge and experience.
You will work in a modern technology environment where you can freely use the latest tools, technologies, and AI-driven solutions to support your work and drive innovation.
To make your workdays more enjoyable, we provide unlimited coffee so you can recharge during breaks and informal moments with your colleagues.
We offer a competitive and above-market salary that reflects your expertise, performance, and the energy you invest in your work.
In addition to competitive base benefits, after successfully completing your probation period you will also receive a high-value cafeteria benefits package that can be flexibly tailored to your personal needs and lifestyle.
The health and well-being of our employees is important to us, which is why after your probation period we provide a comprehensive private health insurance package, allowing you to focus on your work while feeling secure in your everyday life.
In this role, you can expect a high degree of autonomy, giving space for initiative and ownership, while also offering opportunities for rapid professional growth and continuous learning.

As a member of our team, you will be responsible for:

Own the PKI services end to end - architecture, development, maintenance, and how they behave in production.
Develop the certificate authority system and the independent services around it.
Keep the cryptographic stack current and lead upgrades to supported, long-term versions.
Work directly with hardware security modules and the interfaces connecting them to our services.
Make architectural decisions in a security-critical system and see them through to production.
Improve how we build, test, and ship - from local development to deployment.
Ship what you build and keep it healthy: observability, alerting, and a hand in on-call.

This opportunity is for you if you…

have senior-level software engineering experience, primarily in backend development, with a minimum of 3–5 years in production,
are strong in at least one of C, Go or Perl, and genuinely willing to learn and work in all three,
have experience with relational databases (we use MySQL),
have designed and operated systems made up of multiple independent services, and keep them correct across service boundaries,
take long-term responsibility for a system rather than just delivering features into it,
are fluent with AI-assisted coding workflows,
pick up new languages and unfamiliar domains quickly, and find hard problems satisfying rather than draining,
are a native Hungarian speaker (spoken and written) with professional English.

It’s a plus if you...

bring cryptography or PKI knowledge of any kind - it isn't a prerequisite, but we're glad to see it,
have worked with OpenSSL, hardware crypto devices, or PKCS#11,
are at home with Kubernetes and its surrounding tooling,
have built CI/CD pipelines end to end, from build to deployment across Dev, Staging and Prod,
have a background in a regulated, security-critical domain (e.g. eIDAS, trust services, finance),
are open to picking up new scripting languages.

What happens after you apply?

Once your application reaches us, our team carefully reviews it to see how well your experience and skills match the role.
If there’s a strong fit, we’ll invite you to a short introductory phone call to go through the key details and get to know each other.
As a next step, you’ll be invited to a personal interview with our HR team and the hiring manager. This is a great opportunity for you to learn more about the role, the team, and ask any questions about the day-to-day work.

Who we are?

We are a global trust-technology company with more than 25 years of experience in digital identity, advanced cryptography, and qualified trust services. Originating in Hungary and operating internationally with offices in Florida, US and Budapest, HU, we combine European regulatory strength with global reach.

Our team includes one of the region’s largest groups of PKI specialists, cryptographers, and security engineers, experts who have helped shaping the foundations of modern digital trust. As one of Europe’s earliest Qualified Trust Service Providers, we pioneered solutions in electronic signatures, identity verification, cryptographic infrastructure, and content authenticity.
Today, we enable organizations not only to verify identities and sign securely, but to trust their digital world in a way that was never possible before. At the heart of this leap forward is our world-first twin-engine solution: the fusion of C2PA provenance and qualified electronic signatures. This breakthrough creates a verifiable chain of trust for any digital asset, from documents to images to complex media, redefining what authenticity means in the age of AI. It elevates our long-standing trust-service foundations into a new standard for digital truth.

As technology evolves, we are committed to integrating the latest breakthroughs in cryptography, provenance, and AI-driven verification, ensuring trust remains one step ahead of innovation. Our mission is simple: To restore trust in the digital world.

C#, .NET / .NET Core, ASP.NET
REST / SOAP APIs, JSON, XML, web services

Windows Server, IIS, Active Directory / SSO integration

jobs.description:
Job Description

We are seeking a highly skilled, detail-oriented Senior Engineer - Technology Quality Assurance to take complete ownership of our end-to-end testing lifecycle. In this role, you will be the ultimate champion for software quality, ensuring every feature we release meets exceptional standards of functional precision, performance, and user experience.

As a primary quality representative, you will also interface directly with clients to understand feedback and demonstrate product updates. If you have a sharp eye for a polished product, fluent communication skills, and deep expertise across manual, automated, and performance testing, we want to hear from you.

Responsibilities

Complete QA Ownership: Lead and execute the full Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) from initial requirement analysis and test planning to release sign-off and post-launch monitoring.
Automation Framework Design: Own, Build, maintain, and scale robust automated test suites (UI and API) to accelerate integration and regression testing cycles.
Performance & Load Testing: Plan, script, and execute load, stress, and performance tests to ensure systems remain fast, scalable, and resilient under heavy traffic.
Manual & Exploratory Testing: Conduct thorough manual and exploratory testing to catch edge cases, usability flaws, and visual inconsistencies that automated scripts miss.
Product Polish Advocate: Serve as the ultimate filter for product quality, ensuring UI/UX flows are intuitive, seamless, and pixel-perfect prior to release.
Agile Integration: Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Software Engineers, and Designers in an Agile/Scrum environment to refine user stories, define acceptance criteria, and prevent defects early in the sprint cycle.
Defect Management: Identify, document, prioritize, and track bugs to resolution using JIRA (or similar tools), providing clear reproduction steps and detailed diagnostics.
CI/CD Integration: Integrate automated test suites directly into CI/CD deployment pipelines to enable continuous feedback and rapid delivery cycles.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
Minimum of 10 years of hands-on experience as a QA Engineer working on web and mobile applications.
Must have exceptional, highly competent verbal and written English skills for clear documentation, team collaboration, and professional client interactions.
Proven experience designing and implementing automation frameworks using tools such as Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, Appium, or similar.
Solid background in performance testing tools like JMeter, K6, or Gatling.
Strong expertise across manual, API (REST/GraphQL via Postman or RestAssured), cross-browser, and performance testing methodologies.
Extensive experience working in Agile/Scrum methodologies with active participation in sprint planning, daily standups, and retrospectives.
An exceptional eye for detail with a relentless drive to ensure products look, feel, and function flawlessly.
Comfortable writing SQL queries for database verification, inspecting network calls, and analyzing system logs.
Confident and willing to engage directly with clients and stakeholders as needed.

NICE TO HAVE

Experience presenting technical demos or managing UAT sessions with client stakeholders.
Experience with CI/CD tools (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI).
Familiarity with security testing practices and OWASP principles.
ISTQB certification or equivalent software testing credential.

Our Benefits & Perks

Competitive compensation packages and comprehensive medical insurance to support you and your family.
Wellbeing-focused initiatives and resources, designed to enhance your personal and professional life.
Access to exclusive discount programs, offering savings across various lifestyle and leisure experiences across the UAE.

What Makes a Great Fit

If you are performance-driven and possess an inquisitive mind with the agility to navigate ambiguity, you will thrive here. At the heart of the Space42 community is a bias for action and a passion for developing innovative, efficient space services through AI-driven smart solutions that drive technological advancements and create a better tomorrow.

new_jobs.description:
Unternehmensbeschreibung

Everyone’s story matters. Come shape your story with us at Riverty.

But where does that take you?

To one of our 30 hybrid workspaces – designed for exchanging ideas, learning from others, and shaping the way we work. An international community of over 4,000 people, representing almost 80 nationalities across 11 countries. United by one mission: Combining empathy, advanced technology and data-driven insights to keep people and businesses in flow. With payments made for them. So that they don’t have to worry about it.

And there’s more.
We are part of the family-owned Bertelsmann group. Established. Corporate. In a fast-paced industry. We enable flexible payments in various industries, simplifying the financial management of known brands and helping people repay debt to build financial confidence. In short: shaping FinTech.

Stellenbeschreibung

We are looking for a

QA Engineer (m/f/d)

to join our team at our location in Berlin to build the next generation fintech.

Riverty’s partners and consumers rely on absolute precision when money changes hands. In Settlement and Reporting, financial integrity is not a late-stage audit: it is built directly into APIs, accounting workflows, reconciliation pipelines, and test evidence in Jira/Xray.

We are looking for someone who combines a tester’s rigorous domain judgment with an engineer’s delivery habits: you understand complex financial flows, you make ledger and reporting services testable, and you keep CI honest when tracking every cent.

What Will Be Your Challenge

As a QA Engineer, your role will involve developing software specifically for testing, such as tools, frameworks, and automated tests. You will work on enhancing the quality of existing applications by creating tests, conducting testing, and implementing test automation routines. Your daily tasks will include the following:

Planning testing automation for existing and upcoming projects (Unit Tests / Integration Tests including E2E / Performance Tests )
Support the team with quality tests.
Integrate automated tests into Azure Pipelines.
Brainstorm with the team on upcoming projects and keep test/quality in focus, mentoring team members with new testing technologies.
Proactively collaborate with the development team to ensure the code is testable and achieves comprehensive test coverage, helping the team to keep focus on test and quality.
Work closely with the product owner, giving an overview of the status and the upcoming project quality plan.

You Will Be Using Technologies

Languages: C# / .NET, JavaScript / TypeScript, SQL
API & workflow testing: NUnit, xUnit, Postman / Postman CLI, HTTP clients, Gherkin/Xray
BDD / shared test libraries: Reqnroll, Testing Commons, AI agents
Test infrastructure: Docker, Docker Compose, Testcontainers,
CI/CD & Azure: Azure DevOps Pipelines, Azure (Key Vault, storage, ACR), Git
Reporting & test management: Xray, ReportPortal, Jira, Confluence
Performance k6 and/or JMeter
Nice to have: Cypress, Kafka consumer testing

Qualifikationen

What Will Help You To Succeed In The Role

5+ years as SDET / QA Engineer / Quality Engineer, with automated tests in production CI
Solid knowledge of testing types and methods, and the judgment to choose unit vs integration vs functional vs E2E
Strong experience testing complex APIs and integrations (auth, persistence, downstream HTTP, messaging). Comfort reading YAML/JSON configs and tracing behaviour across services.
Proven delivery of automated suites and, ideally, shared test libraries or pipeline templates - not only one-off scripts.
CI/CD, source control, and dependency management as a normal part of the job. Experience in a DevOps-style team.
BDD/Gherkin experience is useful (Xray/Reqnroll). It is not the only style we use; most new service tests are NUnit/xUnit. Comfort with mixed unit/integration/functional/E2E across repos.
Curiosity about AI-assisted testing is a plus. Willingness to review, correct, and constrain generated tests is required.
As a person you are self-driven, proactive, and able to talk to both business and engineering stakeholders and fluent in English

Zusätzliche Informationen

Our Plus Points

Inclusive and valuing culture: At Riverty, you can be who you are. We strive to create an inclusive environment and an appreciative culture, enhanced by our employee networks.
Health & Wellbeing: Your physical and mental health is important to us. Take advantage of our various preventive care and support services.
Professional and Personal Development: Take advantage of our numerous training and development opportunities. Benefit, for example, from training courses offered by Bertelsmann University, language courses or leadership trainings.
Monetary Benefits & Discounts: Know that you're appreciated with plenty of employee benefits & discounts just for you.
Flexibility: Our diverse working models empower you to customize your work to perfectly align with your preferences. Benefit from mobile office, flexible working hours and part-time models.

More information on riverty.com/careers. Are you already convinced? Then we look forward to receiving your online application – with just a few clicks

Equal Opportunity Employer Statement

We want to be a fair and inclusive employer. We value the diverse perspectives that a diverse workforce brings to the table. Therefore, we are actively looking for people who enrich our company through their identity, background and personal experiences, with or without a disability.

We are hiring for four roles at Ulvi.

Ulvi is a character-based AI app that people talk to every day. Every character has a voice, an environment, and a capability of their own: one reads dreams, one pulls tarot, one runs breathing sessions, one helps you sort a messy decision, and new characters bring new capabilities. We launched in August 2026 and we are building for a global audience, with Türkiye and Brazil as our first focus markets. The team is small, so what you ship goes live quickly and you get to watch people actually use it.

OPEN ROLES

Character & UI Designer
— Mid-level, 3+ years

Draw our characters and design the product they live in. Two crafts, one role.
ulvi.ai/en/careers/character-ui-designer

Character Writer — Mid-level, 2+ years

Invent the cast and write them: the person, the voice, and the world they live in.
ulvi.ai/en/careers/character-writer

Conversation Quality Analyst — Mid-level, 2+ years

Read what the AI actually said, decide whether it was good, and know what to change.
ulvi.ai/en/careers/conversation-quality-analyst

Backend Developer (Laravel) — Early career, 0-3 years

Own the services behind Ulvi: identity, billing, tokens, the store, the conversation API.
ulvi.ai/en/careers/backend-developer

- Fully remote, from anywhere in Türkiye.
- Full-time. Working hours are 10:00-18:00 (TR).

- Written-first: short status notes, decisions in documents, few meetings.
- Bring your own device: we do not provide hardware.
- Communication runs on Discord.

- We care about what you can do more than where you learned it. Nobody here will ask which university you went to, or whether you went at all.

HOW TO APPLY

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design, develop, and optimize high-impact systems that power Sezzle’s financial reporting, reconciliation, and automation workflows. You’ll partner closely with cross-functional teams — including Accounting and Finance — to ensure data integrity, streamline financial processes, and build robust, auditable systems that meet enterprise-grade standards.

:

USD per month. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level, offering a competitive salary to reflect the value of advanced skills and experience.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance and maintain software solutions for financial processes.

Leverage accounting background to identify gaps and improve automation and reconciliation workflows.

At least 7 years of full-stack software engineering experience
Experience bringing new ideas and building consensus on the path forward
Experience with building and serving REST APIs using Go and Java Python or a similar language.
